SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026: The State Bank of India (SBI) is expected to announce the SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination Result 2026 for regular Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) vacancies on 17 November 2026. However, SBI has not confirmed the result release date or time. Candidates who appeared for the examination on 26 and 27 September 2026 can check their qualifying status at sbi.bank.in once the official result link is activated.

The SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 for regular vacancies under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17 is currently awaited. Candidates shortlisted in the preliminary examination will be eligible to appear for the SBI Clerk Mains Examination, tentatively scheduled for 26 and 27 November 2026. Applicants should regularly check the SBI Careers portal for the result announcement, scorecard and further examination instructions.

SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 - Overview

The important details of the SBI Clerk Junior Associate Preliminary Examination Result 2026 are provided below.

Particulars Details
Organization State Bank of India (SBI)
Post Name Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales)
Advertisement Number CRPD/CR/2026-27/17
Recruitment Type Regular Vacancies
Prelims Exam Date 26 and 27 September 2026
SBI Clerk Prelims Result Date 17 November 2026 (Expected, Not Confirmed)
Result Status Awaited

SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 Latest Update

As of 17 November 2026, the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 for regular Junior Associate vacancies has not been officially announced. The result is expected soon, and several reports have indicated 17 November as a possible release date. However, candidates should note that SBI has not confirmed the exact date or time.

The official SBI recruitment portal currently lists the regular Junior Associate recruitment under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17. The preliminary result link will be available in the relevant recruitment section after the bank publishes it.

Important: The SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 for the separate SC/ST/OBC backlog recruitment was released earlier. Candidates appearing under the regular recruitment should not confuse the backlog result with the pending regular vacancy result.

SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 Important Dates

Candidates waiting for the SBI Clerk Pre Result 2026 can check the important examination and result dates below.

Event Date / Status
SBI Clerk Prelims Examination 26 and 27 September 2026
SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 Expected on 17 November 2026
Prelims Scorecard To Be Announced
Prelims Cut Off To Be Announced
SBI Clerk Mains Examination 26 and 27 November 2026 (Tentative)
Mains Admit Card As notified by SBI

SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 Download Link

The SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 download link for regular vacancies will be available on the official SBI Careers website after the announcement. Candidates should look for the Preliminary Examination Result under the Junior Associate recruitment, Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.

The result may be published as a list of shortlisted candidates. If SBI provides a downloadable result PDF, candidates can search for their roll numbers to check whether they have qualified for the Mains Examination. Scorecard access may be provided separately through a candidate login facility.

Official SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 Link: Check Result Status at SBI Careers

Result Status: Link awaited for regular vacancies. The above link opens the official recruitment portal and is not a direct result PDF.

How to Check SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to check their SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 after the official link is activated.

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers website at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Open the Current Openings or Recruitment Results section.
  3. Find Recruitment of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales).
  4. Check Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17 for regular vacancies.
  5. Click the Preliminary Examination Result link when it becomes available.
  6. If SBI publishes a PDF, download it and search for your roll number.
  7. If the result is provided through a login portal, enter the details requested by SBI.
  8. Check your qualifying status and save the result for future reference.

SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 for Regular Vacancies

The SBI Clerk Regular Prelims Result 2026 relates to the Junior Associate recruitment conducted under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17. Candidates who appeared in the September 2026 preliminary examination are waiting for the result announcement.

SBI is also conducting a separate Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC backlog vacancies under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16. The preliminary result for that recruitment has already been published.

Both recruitments have separate advertisement numbers and result updates. Candidates should check the result corresponding to the recruitment for which they applied.

SBI Clerk Prelims Scorecard 2026

The SBI Clerk Prelims Scorecard 2026 will provide candidates with information about their preliminary examination performance. SBI is expected to provide a separate facility for checking marks after the relevant announcement.

Depending on the official scorecard format, candidates may be able to view their examination marks and applicable cut-off details. The release date of the regular recruitment scorecard has not yet been confirmed.

Candidates should use only the official SBI scorecard link to verify their marks. The preliminary result and the individual marks facility may be published at different times.

SBI Clerk Prelims Cut Off 2026

The SBI Clerk Prelims Cut Off 2026 for regular Junior Associate vacancies will be available after SBI publishes the relevant result and cut-off information. Cut-off marks can vary according to the recruitment state or union territory and the candidate's category.

Candidates should compare their marks with the official cut-off applicable to their state and category. Expected cut-off estimates circulated before the official announcement should not be treated as confirmed qualifying marks.

The SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination is a qualifying stage. Marks obtained in the Prelims Examination are not added to the final merit calculation.

SBI Clerk Mains Exam Date 2026

The State Bank of India has tentatively scheduled the SBI Clerk Mains Examination 2026 for 26 and 27 November 2026 under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17. Candidates who qualify in the Preliminary Examination will be eligible for the next stage of recruitment.

The bank will provide further information about the Mains examination, including candidate-specific schedules, reporting instructions and call letters through its official recruitment portal.

For the complete examination schedule and latest updates, read SBI Clerk Mains Exam Date 2026.

What Happens After SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination will proceed to the Mains Examination. They should check the official SBI recruitment updates and prepare according to the prescribed Mains syllabus and examination pattern.

  • Check the SBI Clerk Prelims qualifying status.
  • Download the official result and scorecard when available.
  • Review the applicable state-wise and category-wise cut-off marks.
  • Check the Mains examination schedule and call letter updates.
  • Prepare for the Mains Examination on the tentatively scheduled dates.

Final selection will follow the applicable recruitment rules, including Mains performance and the local language requirements wherever applicable.

AP Special TET Result 2026 Out: The Department of School Education, Andhra Pradesh, released the Andhra Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test (AP Special TET) Result 2026 on 16 November 2026 for in-service teachers. Candidates who appeared in the examination conducted from 11 to 15 October 2026 can check their results and qualifying status through the official website at tet2dsc.apcfss.in. The examination recorded an overall paper-wise pass percentage of 96.06%, with 79,743 qualifying papers out of 83,015 paper applications submitted by 68,420 teachers.

The AP Special TET Scorecard 2026 is available through the official candidate portal. Teachers can access their marks memo using the login details requested by the website. Candidates should download their results, verify their marks and qualifying status, and retain a copy for future reference.

The Andhra Pradesh School Education Department has announced the Special Teacher Eligibility Test results for serving teachers. The important examination and result details are provided below.

Overall Paper-wise Pass Percentage 96.06%

AP Special TET Result 2026 Download Link

The AP Special TET Result 2026 link is available through the official Andhra Pradesh TET portal. In-service teachers can access their results by opening the Special TET result section and entering the required candidate details.

Candidates should use the official portal to view their marks memo and qualifying status. The result facility is accessed through the candidate login, rather than a publicly available merit-list PDF containing all candidates' individual results.

AP Special TET Result 2026 Direct Portal Link: Check AP Special TET Result and Download Scorecard

Note: The link above opens the official AP TET portal. Candidates should select the Special TET result option displayed on the website.

AP Special TET Result 2026 Latest Updates

The Andhra Pradesh School Education Department announced the results of the Special Teacher Eligibility Test on 16 November 2026. According to the reported official press note, the examination achieved a paper-wise pass percentage of 96.06%.

A total of 68,420 serving teachers submitted applications for 83,015 examination papers because some teachers applied for more than one paper. Of these, 79,743 papers met the qualifying requirements.

The examination was conducted in computer-based mode from 11 to 15 October 2026. The department released the provisional answer key, considered objections and finalised the results after the answer-key review process.

AP Special TET Result 2026 Statistics

The important result statistics announced for the Andhra Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 are listed below.

Particulars Details
Total Teachers Who Applied 68,420
Total Paper Applications 83,015
Qualifying Papers 79,743
Overall Paper-wise Pass Percentage 96.06%

Important: The number of qualifying papers should not be confused with the number of individual teachers who qualified. Some candidates registered for more than one examination paper.

How to Check AP Special TET Result 2026?

In-service teachers can follow the steps below to check their AP Special TET 2026 results through the official website.

  1. Visit the official website at tet2dsc.apcfss.in.
  2. Find the AP Special TET Result 2026 link on the homepage.
  3. Open the result or marks memo download section.
  4. Enter the candidate login details requested by the portal.
  5. Complete any additional verification displayed on the page.
  6. Submit the details to view the examination result.
  7. Check the marks obtained and qualifying status.
  8. Download and save the AP Special TET Scorecard 2026 for future reference.

Candidates should ensure that the details entered on the login page match their official examination registration records.

AP Special TET Scorecard 2026

The AP Special TET Scorecard 2026, also referred to as the marks memo, provides information about the candidate's performance in the Teacher Eligibility Test. Candidates can check their marks and whether they have secured the minimum qualifying score applicable to their category.

Teachers should download their scorecards from the official portal and verify the information carefully. If any discrepancy is found, they should follow the correction or grievance instructions issued by the School Education Department.

Details Mentioned on AP Special TET Marks Memo 2026

Candidates should verify the following information where it appears on their scorecards:

  • Candidate's name
  • Hall ticket or registration details
  • Examination paper
  • Category details
  • Marks obtained
  • Maximum marks
  • Qualifying status
  • Other examination-related information

Candidates should preserve a copy of their marks memo for future verification and service-related requirements.

AP Special TET Qualifying Marks 2026

The AP Special TET qualifying marks vary according to the candidate's category. The examination carries 150 marks per paper, and the reported category-wise qualifying percentages are given below.

Category Qualifying Percentage Minimum Marks (Out of 150)
OC / EWS 60% 90
BC 50% 75
SC / ST / PwBD 40% 60

Candidates should check the applicable qualifying criteria and category provisions in the official AP Special TET notification. Securing the minimum qualifying marks establishes TET eligibility under the applicable rules; it does not guarantee appointment or promotion.

AP Special TET Result 2026 - Important Dates

Event Date
AP Special TET Examination 11 to 15 October 2026
Initial Answer Key 24 October 2026
Answer Key Objection Deadline 1 November 2026
Final Answer Key 10 November 2026 (Scheduled)
AP Special TET Result Declaration 16 November 2026

AP Special TET 2026 Result and High Court Case Update

A public interest litigation concerning the conduct of the AP Special TET 2026 examination has been reported before the Andhra Pradesh High Court. The case involves allegations relating to the examination question bank and answer options.

According to reports, the High Court directed the authorities to preserve relevant examination records, including question papers, answer keys and digital records. The matter was reported to have been adjourned to 16 December 2026.

The examination results have been announced, and no final judicial determination invalidating the examination has been established in the reviewed reports. Candidates should follow official government announcements and court updates rather than treating the allegations as proven findings.

What Happens After AP Special TET Result 2026?

Candidates who have qualified in the AP Special Teacher Eligibility Test should retain their scorecards and follow the instructions issued by the Andhra Pradesh School Education Department regarding eligibility certificates and their use.

The Special TET was conducted for in-service teachers to meet applicable teacher eligibility requirements. Qualifying the examination may be relevant to service-related eligibility and future recruitment processes, subject to the rules governing the candidate's appointment and service conditions.

Passing the AP Special TET does not automatically guarantee promotion, continued employment under every circumstance, or appointment to another teaching post. Candidates should refer to the applicable government orders and service rules.

The Mahatransco Apprentice 2026 list is based on the average of each candidate's combined SSC and ITI (Electrician) marks. Caste, category and the other details given in the application were also used.

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026 for the Prison and Correctional Services Department recruitment examination. The admission ticket download facility is available for the RPC (Residual Parent Cadre) recruitment. Candidates appearing for Jailor, Warder and Instructor Grade-II posts can access their hall tickets through the official KEA examination portal at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.

The Karnataka KEA Prison written examination is scheduled for 21 November 2026 for the RPC/Basic Cadre and 22 November 2026 for the Kalyana Karnataka (KK) Cadre. Candidates can download their admission tickets using their Application Number or Enrolment ID, the first six letters of their name and the captcha code. Applicants should verify the examination date, reporting time and centre details printed on their hall tickets before appearing for the examination.

Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026 Download Link

The Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026 download link is available through the official KEA examination portal. Candidates appearing for the RPC/Basic Cadre examination can access the admission ticket login page and download their hall tickets.

The KK Cadre admission ticket release status should be checked separately on the official portal. Applicants must select the appropriate examination option before entering their login details.

Download Admit Card: Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026 Direct Link

Official Website: Visit KEA Official Website

How to Download Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026?

Candidates can follow the steps below to download their Karnataka KEA Prison admission tickets:

  1. Visit the official KEA website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.
  2. Open the Admission Ticket (ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪತ್ರ) download section.
  3. Select the appropriate Prison Department Recruitment examination from the Exam Type dropdown.
  4. Enter the Application Number or Enrolment ID.
  5. Enter the first six letters of the candidate's name exactly as provided in the application.
  6. Enter the captcha code displayed on the screen.
  7. Submit the details to access the admission ticket.
  8. Check the examination date, reporting time, centre address and candidate details.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout for the examination.

Karnataka KEA Prison Exam Date 2026

The Karnataka Examinations Authority has scheduled the Prison and Correctional Services Department written examinations for 21 and 22 November 2026. A separate Kannada Language examination is also scheduled for eligible candidates on 20 November 2026.

Examination Exam Date Timing
Kannada Language Examination (Applicable Candidates) 20 November 2026 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM
RPC / Basic Cadre - General Knowledge 21 November 2026 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM
Kalyana Karnataka Cadre - General Knowledge 22 November 2026 10:30 AM to 12:00 PM

Candidates should refer to their admission tickets and the latest KEA examination instructions for the applicable paper, reporting time and examination centre. Any additional language examination requirements should be checked against the official schedule.

Details Mentioned on Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026

After downloading the admission ticket, candidates should verify the following details wherever applicable:

  • Candidate's full name and roll number
  • Application Number or Enrolment ID
  • Post name and recruitment cadre
  • Candidate's photograph and signature
  • Examination date and shift timing
  • Reporting time and gate closing time
  • Examination centre name and address
  • Important examination instructions

If any information is incorrect, candidates should contact the Karnataka Examinations Authority through the official communication channels before the examination.

Karnataka KEA Prison Admit Card 2026 Exam Day Instructions

Candidates appearing for the Karnataka KEA Prison recruitment examination should carefully read the instructions provided on their admission tickets and the official KEA website.

  • Carry a printed copy of the admission ticket and an original photo identity document accepted by KEA.
  • Check the examination centre location and reporting time in advance.
  • Follow the dress code instructions published on the official KEA website.
  • Carry only the items permitted under the examination guidelines.
  • Do not carry prohibited electronic devices such as mobile phones, smartwatches or calculators into the examination hall.
  • Follow the instructions regarding OMR answer sheets and permitted writing materials.
  • Reach the examination centre before the reporting and gate closing times mentioned on the hall ticket.

CGSSB Nagar Sena Exam Day Instructions 2026

CGSSB has set rules for the NSSK26 exam on ID proof, dress code and banned items. Candidates who break them will not be allowed to take the exam.

  • One original photo ID: Voter ID card, Driving Licence, PAN Card or Aadhaar Card. Candidates without an original ID will not be allowed into the centre.

Dress Code

  • Wear light-coloured, half-sleeve clothes. Black, dark blue, dark green, jamuni (purple), maroon, baingani (violet) and dark chocolate clothes are not allowed.
  • A plain sweater without pockets is allowed. The light-colour and half-sleeve rule does not apply to sweaters, but you must take the sweater off for the security check.
  • Wear chappals (slippers) as footwear.
  • Ear jewellery of any kind is not allowed.
  • Candidates in religious or cultural dress must report earlier than the normal time and go through an extra security check.

Other Rules

  • You may not leave the exam hall in the first half hour or the last half hour of the exam.
  • Communication devices, electronic devices, electronic watches, purses, pouches, scarves, belts and caps are not allowed in the exam hall.
  • Using unfair means will lead to strict action, and the candidate's candidature will be cancelled.
  • For any problem with the exam centre, call helpline 0771-2972780 or mobile 8827920164 between 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM.

How to Download IBPS PO Mains Admit Card 2026?

If you have misplaced your registration number or password, you can retrieve it using the steps below:

Important Instructions for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must follow these exam-day guidelines carefully:

  • Carry a printed copy of the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card along with an original valid photo ID proof.
  • Reach the exam centre at least 30 to 45 minutes before the reporting time mentioned on the call letter.
  • Carry 2 to 3 passport-size photographs identical to the one uploaded on the call letter.
  • Electronic devices, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, and study materials are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at the exam centre to maintain the integrity of the process.
  • Ensure the photograph and signature printed on the admit card are clear and legible.
  • Scribe-related documents are required only for candidates using a registered scribe under PwBD guidelines.

  1. Verify your name spelling, date of birth, registration number, and category carefully.
  2. Check whether your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the centre name, shift timing, and full address are correct.
  4. Contact the IBPS helpdesk through the official support email or helpline number given on the portal.
  5. Keep your online application form and registration acknowledgement ready for faster resolution.
  6. Download the corrected admit card once the issue has been updated by IBPS.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Date and Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO Mains exam will be held on 4 October 2026. It is a Computer-Based Test that evaluates candidates on Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language, and Data Analysis & Interpretation, along with a descriptive English Language Writing Test (Essay & Letter). Negative marking applies for wrong answers in the objective sections. Exact sectional timings, marks distribution, and negative-marking ratio are not available in the source material used for this article and should be checked on the admit card and the official notification.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Northern Railway has released the RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification for 4,651 Act Apprentice training slots under Advertisement No. RRC/NR/03/2026/Act Apprentice. Candidates who have passed Class 10 with at least 50% marks and possess an ITI certificate in the relevant trade can apply for apprenticeship training across Northern Railway divisions and workshops.

The RRC NR Apprentice 2026 online application process started on 11 November 2026, and eligible candidates can apply through the official website www.rrcnr.org until 11 December 2026 (11:59 PM). Selection will be based on Class 10 and ITI marks without a written examination or interview. Candidates should check the vacancy details, eligibility, age limit and application fee before submitting their forms.

RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organisation Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Northern Railway
Post Name Act Apprentice
Total Vacancies 4,651
Advertisement Number RRC/NR/03/2026/Act Apprentice
Job Type Apprenticeship Training (2026–27)
Qualification 10th Pass (Minimum 50% Marks) + ITI in Relevant Trade
Age Limit 15 to 24 Years (as on 11 December 2026)
Application Start Date 11 November 2026
Last Date to Apply 11 December 2026
Application Mode Online
Selection Process Merit-Based (10th and ITI Marks)
Training Location Northern Railway Divisions, Units and Workshops
Official Notification Download PDF
Official Website www.rrcnr.org

RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Eligible candidates can submit the RRC NR Apprentice online application form from 11 November to 11 December 2026. The merit list is expected to be displayed in February 2027.

Event Date
Notification Release Date 06 November 2026
Online Application Start Date 11 November 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 11 December 2026 (11:59 PM)
Expected Merit List February 2027

RRC NR Apprentice Vacancy 2026 – Cluster-Wise Details

Northern Railway has announced 4,651 Act Apprentice training slots across six clusters. Candidates can check the cluster-wise vacancy distribution below.

Railway Cluster Total Vacancies
Lucknow (LKO) 1,525
Delhi (DLI) 1,312
Ambala (UMB) 979
Firozpur (FZR) 740
Moradabad (MB) 63
Jammu 32
Total 4,651

Candidates must check the trade-wise and unit-wise training slots in Annexure-A of the official notification before selecting a cluster. Applications submitted for units where the candidate's ITI trade is not notified may be rejected.

RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for Northern Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the notification.

Educational Qualification

  • Must have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) or equivalent under the 10+2 examination system from a recognised board.
  • Must have secured at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 10.
  • Must possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade recognised by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Both Class 10 and ITI qualifications must have been completed on or before 06 November 2026.

Note: Candidates awaiting their Class 10 or ITI results as of the notification date are not eligible to apply.

RRC NR Apprentice Age Limit 2026

The age limit for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 11 December 2026.

Minimum Age 15 Years
Maximum Age 24 Years
Age Calculation Date 11 December 2026

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST: 5 Years
  • OBC: 3 Years
  • PwBD: 10 Years
  • Ex-Servicemen: As per the conditions mentioned in the official notification

RRC NR Apprentice Application Fee 2026

The application fee must be paid online while submitting the RRC NR Apprentice application form.

Category Application Fee
General / OBC / EWS Rs. 100
SC / ST No Fee
PwBD No Fee
Women Candidates No Fee

The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable online transaction charges, if any, must be paid by the candidate.

RRC NR Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection for RRC NR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit calculated from Class 10 and ITI marks. There will be no written examination or interview.

  • Screening and scrutiny of online applications.
  • Preparation of merit lists based on the average percentage of Class 10 and ITI marks, with equal weightage.
  • Document verification of shortlisted candidates.
  • Fulfilment of prescribed medical fitness requirements.

Merit Calculation: (Class 10 Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2

If two candidates receive the same merit score, preference will be given to the older candidate. If their dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.

RRC NR Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a stipend during their training according to the applicable Apprenticeship Rules. The official RRC NR notification does not specify a fixed monthly stipend amount for each trade.

Apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment in Northern Railway after completion of the training period.

How to Apply Online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the official website before 11 December 2026.

  1. Visit the official Northern Railway RRC website at www.rrcnr.org.
  2. Find the Engagement of Act Apprentice 2026 online application link.
  3. Complete registration using your personal details, mobile number and email ID.
  4. Log in using the registration credentials.
  5. Enter the required personal, educational and ITI qualification details.
  6. Select the appropriate cluster and unit based on the available slots for your ITI trade.
  7. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and certificates.
  8. Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
  9. Review the details and submit the application form.
  10. Download and print the submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Important: Only one application is permitted per candidate. Multiple applications may lead to rejection, and changes are not allowed after final submission.

Central Railway Apprentice 2026: Railway Recruitment Cell, Central Railway (RRC CR), has released Notification No. RRC/CR/AA/2026 dated 3 November 2026 for engagement of 2,861 Act Apprentices across its Mumbai, Bhusawal, Pune, Nagpur and Solapur clusters. Candidates who have passed Class 10 with at least 50% aggregate marks and possess an NCVT/SCVT certificate in the relevant ITI trade can apply. The age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 3 November 2026, with applicable relaxation. Selected apprentices will receive a stipend of Rs. 9,600 per month during one year of training. The online application process started on 3 November 2026 and closes on 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official RRC Central Railway website at www.rrccr.com.

Important: This notification is for apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and does not offer permanent railway employment. Candidates who are currently undergoing or have already completed apprenticeship training should not apply. Applicants must choose only one cluster and ensure their ITI trade has available training slots in the selected units.

Which ITI Trades Are Available in Central Railway Apprentice 2026?

The recruitment includes apprenticeship opportunities in mechanical, electrical, engineering, computer, communication and other designated trades.

  • Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
  • Stenographer (English or Hindi Shorthand)
  • Tailor / Sewing Technology / Dress Making
  • Other notified technical trades

Important: Not every trade is available in every cluster or workshop. The applicant's ITI certificate must match the eligible trade qualification listed against the chosen training slot. Candidates should verify the exact trade name and unit availability in the official PDF.

Central Railway Act Apprentice 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must have passed Class 10 with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognized board and hold an appropriate ITI trade certificate issued or provisionally certified by NCVT/SCVT.

Educational Qualification

Requirement Details
Academic Qualification Class 10 or Equivalent under the 10+2 Examination System
Minimum Class 10 Marks 50% Aggregate
Technical Qualification National Trade Certificate in the Notified Trade Issued by NCVT
Accepted Provisional Certificate Provisional National Trade Certificate Issued by NCVT / SCVT
Engineering Degree / Diploma Applicants Not Eligible under This Notification

Important Qualification Restriction: Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for apprenticeship under this specific notification, as they are covered by a separate apprenticeship scheme. Applicants must satisfy the exact Class 10 and ITI eligibility requirements stated by RRC Central Railway.

Can 10th Pass Candidates Apply Without ITI?

No. Class 10 with at least 50% aggregate marks is required, but candidates must also possess the prescribed ITI trade certificate. A 10th Pass qualification alone does not meet the recruitment eligibility.

Can Candidates Who Have Already Completed Apprenticeship Apply?

No. The notification specifically states that candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship or who have already undergone apprenticeship training should not apply.

Central Railway Act Apprentice Age Limit 2026

The age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 3 November 2026. Candidates belonging to eligible reserved categories may receive upper-age relaxation.

Both dates are inclusive. These date-of-birth ranges are reproduced from the official notification. PwBD and eligible Ex-Servicemen candidates should check the additional age-relaxation rules applicable to their category.

Central Railway Act Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected Act Apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 9,600, as specified under Railway Board RBE No. 116/2025 dated 11 November 2025.

Particulars Details
Apprentice Qualification National or State Trade Certificate Holder
Monthly Stipend Rs. 9,600
Training Duration 1 Year
Hostel Accommodation Not Provided
Regular Railway Salary Not Applicable

Stipend Clarification: Rs. 9,600 is the notified monthly apprenticeship stipend, not the basic salary of a permanent railway employee. Selected candidates must arrange their own accommodation during training.

Central Railway Act Apprentice Training Duration 2026

The duration of apprenticeship training is one year for all notified trades. Selected candidates must enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship Training before the programme begins.

Particulars Details
Programme Act Apprenticeship Training
Governing Law Apprentices Act, 1961
Training Period 1 Year
Training Location Selected Central Railway Unit / Workshop
Apprenticeship Contract Mandatory Before Training
Permanent Employment Guarantee No

For selected applicants who are minors, the apprenticeship contract must be entered into by their guardian. Premature termination of the contract may have consequences under the applicable apprenticeship rules.

Will Central Railway Provide a Permanent Job After Apprenticeship?

No. Central Railway clearly states that completing apprenticeship training does not guarantee employment or automatic absorption into Railway service. The Railway administration is not obligated to provide a permanent job after the training period.

RRC Central Railway Act Apprentice Application Fee 2026

The application fee is Rs. 100 for candidates who are not covered by the notified exemptions. SC, ST, PwBD and women candidates are exempt.

Payment Mode: Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through the integrated online payment gateway.

The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable payment transaction charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate.

What If the Application Fee Is Deducted but Payment Is Not Confirmed?

RRC Central Railway advises candidates to use the Verify Payment option if their payment is deducted but the application confirmation cannot be downloaded. Candidates should verify the original transaction before attempting another payment, since duplicate payments may not be refunded.

Central Railway Act Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection will be based on a merit list calculated using the simple average of Class 10 and ITI percentage marks. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview.

  1. Online Application: Candidates apply through the RRC Central Railway website.
  2. Merit Calculation: Class 10 aggregate percentage and ITI percentage are given equal weightage.
  3. Merit List Preparation: Lists are prepared cluster-wise, unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise.
  4. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original educational and category certificates.
  5. Medical Fitness: Candidates must present the prescribed medical fitness certificate.
  6. Apprenticeship Engagement: Eligible candidates are engaged for training after completing the necessary formalities.

Important: Although RRC Central Railway has issued a centralized notification, it will not prepare one centralized merit list for all 2,861 slots. Selection is organized according to the relevant cluster, unit, trade and community.

How Is Central Railway Apprentice Merit Calculated?

The official merit formula is:

Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Aggregate Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2

Qualification Example Percentage
Class 10 Aggregate Marks 80%
ITI Marks 90%
Calculated Merit Percentage 85%

This is an illustrative calculation, not an actual selection cut-off. Candidates must enter accurate percentages based on the aggregate Class 10 marks and the prescribed consolidated ITI marks.

How Are Grade-Based Class 10 Marks Calculated?

For boards that award letter grades rather than percentages, candidates must calculate the percentage using the midpoint of the marks range corresponding to the overall grade.

If the education board does not issue an overall grade, the midpoints of individual subject-grade ranges must be averaged according to the notification's instructions.

For example, if the overall grade corresponds to the range 80-89%, the midpoint is 84.5%. Candidates should use the conversion instructions given on pages 2 and 3 of the official PDF. Incorrect calculation may lead to rejection during verification.

Central Railway Apprentice Tie-Breaking Rules

If two candidates obtain the same merit percentage, the older candidate will receive preference. If their dates of birth are also identical, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier will be placed higher.

Is There a Written Exam for Railway Apprentice 2026?

No separate written examination is specified for this Central Railway Act Apprentice engagement. Candidates are shortlisted according to their Class 10 and ITI marks, followed by document verification and medical fitness assessment.

Applicants should not confuse this apprenticeship selection with Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) CBT examinations conducted for regular railway posts.

Central Railway Apprentice Reservation Rules 2026

Reservation applies to eligible SC, ST, OBC, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen categories according to the relevant notification provisions.

SC, ST and OBC Reservation Certificates

SC and ST candidates claiming reservation must upload the appropriate caste certificate in the prescribed Central Government format.

OBC candidates must submit a valid caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026, in the prescribed Central Government format.

Original certificates must be produced during document verification.

PwBD Eligibility and Reservation

PwBD eligibility is restricted to the disability categories and trade-specific fitness conditions stated in the notification. The applicable provisions include certain locomotor disabilities, cerebral palsy, hearing disabilities and low-vision categories.

Candidates claiming PwBD reservation must possess a valid disability certificate from the competent medical authority. Not every disability category is suitable for every apprenticeship trade, and applicants must check the requirements applicable to their selected trade.

Ex-Servicemen Reservation

The advertisement provides reservation provisions for eligible Ex-Servicemen and certain children of Ex-Servicemen or serving Armed Forces personnel.

Applicants claiming these benefits must upload the required discharge or serving certificate and produce the original supporting documents when called for verification.

Central Railway Apprentice 2026 Apply Online

Candidates can submit online applications through the official RRC Central Railway Apprentice 2026 recruitment portal. The application window is open from 3 November to 2 December 2026.

Direct Apply Online: Central Railway Apprentice 2026 Application Portal

Official Website: www.rrccr.com

Notification Number: RRC/CR/AA/2026.

Last Date: 2 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

Applicants must select only one cluster and may give unit preferences within that cluster. Multiple applications are not permitted and may result in cancellation of all applications submitted by the candidate.

How to Apply Online for Central Railway Apprentice 2026?

  1. Visit the official Railway Recruitment Cell, Central Railway website at www.rrccr.com.
  2. Locate Notification No. RRC/CR/AA/2026 for engagement of Act Apprentices.
  3. Download and read the complete notification before applying.
  4. Check the available ITI trades, cluster-wise vacancies, age criteria and educational requirements.
  5. Click the Apply Online link for the 2026 apprenticeship engagement.
  6. Complete the registration process using the information requested on the portal.
  7. Enter personal details, including name, parents' names, date of birth and contact information.
  8. Provide the required Aadhaar or other permitted identification details.
  9. Enter Class 10 qualification and aggregate percentage marks accurately.
  10. Enter the relevant ITI trade certificate and marks details.
  11. Select only one eligible cluster.
  12. Choose the available units within the selected cluster in order of preference.
  13. Enter the applicable community, reservation and other eligibility details.
  14. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting certificates.
  15. Review the completed application carefully before final submission.
  16. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100, unless exempt.
  17. Complete the application process before 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
  18. Download and print the application form and retain the registration number and payment receipt.

Important: Candidates should not submit multiple applications using different mobile numbers, email addresses or personal particulars. RRC Central Railway may reject all applications submitted by the same candidate.

Documents Required for Central Railway Apprentice 2026

Applicants must upload legible scanned copies of the required educational and supporting documents during the online application process.

  • Class 10 or equivalent marksheet.
  • Date-of-birth proof through Matriculation certificate, marksheet or accepted school leaving certificate.
  • Consolidated ITI marksheet covering all semesters of the notified trade.
  • National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT or accepted provisional certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT.
  • SC/ST/OBC caste certificate, where applicable.
  • Valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable.
  • Disability certificate for eligible PwBD applicants.
  • Discharge certificate or Armed Forces serving certificate for applicable Ex-Servicemen reservation claims.
  • Prescribed recent colour photograph.
  • Scanned candidate signature.
  • Aadhaar or other permitted identity document details.

Original documents must be produced during document verification. Documents issued in languages other than Hindi or English must be accompanied by the required attested translation.

Central Railway Apprentice Photograph and Signature Size

Document Format Dimensions File Size
Photograph JPG / JPEG 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm 20 KB - 70 KB
Signature JPG / JPEG 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm 20 KB - 30 KB

Both images must follow the prescribed 100 DPI specification. The colour photograph must have been taken within three months before application and should show the candidate's face clearly without a cap or sunglasses.

Applicants should retain two additional copies of the same photograph for document verification.

Aadhaar and Identity Requirements for RRC CR Apprentice 2026

Applicants are generally required to enter their 12-digit Aadhaar number during registration. Those who have applied for Aadhaar but have not received the card may enter the 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID.

The notification provides special identification provisions for applicants from Jammu & Kashmir, Meghalaya and Assam. Eligible applicants from these locations may use a permitted Government identity document such as Voter ID, valid passport or driving licence.

The original accepted identification document must be produced during document verification.

Central Railway Apprentice Document Verification 2026

Candidates shortlisted through the merit process will be called for document verification in the relevant division or unit according to their selected cluster.

They must produce the original educational certificates, ITI marksheets, reservation certificates, identity documents and other applicable records.

Medical Fitness Certificate

Shortlisted candidates must bring the prescribed medical fitness certificate in the format provided in Annexure VII of the official notification.

The certificate must be signed by a Government-authorized Gazetted medical officer not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon in a Central or State Government hospital.

Important: Candidates who fail to produce the required medical fitness certificate may not be permitted to undergo document verification and may have their candidature cancelled.

Common Reasons for Rejection of Railway Apprentice Applications

Applicants should carefully review the following requirements because errors may lead to rejection:

  • Not meeting the minimum Class 10 aggregate marks or prescribed ITI qualification.
  • Selecting a unit where no training slots are available for the applicant's ITI trade.
  • Submitting more than one application.
  • Entering incorrect Class 10 or ITI percentages.
  • Providing personal details that do not match the Matriculation certificate.
  • Uploading unclear, corrupt or incorrect documents.
  • Failing to produce the required original certificates during verification.
  • Claiming reservation without the prescribed supporting certificates.
  • Not meeting the applicable age limit.
  • Failing to produce the required medical fitness certificate.
  • Providing false or misleading information.

Applicants should check the complete notification and all entered information before paying the fee and submitting the final application, as editing is not permitted after final submission.

Central Railway Act Apprentice 2026 Important Instructions

  • RRC Central Railway has announced 2,861 Act Apprentice training slots.
  • The notification number is RRC/CR/AA/2026, dated 3 November 2026.
  • Applications close on 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
  • Class 10 with at least 50% aggregate marks and the relevant ITI certificate are mandatory.
  • The prescribed age limit is 15 to 24 years, with applicable relaxation.
  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible under this notification.
  • Candidates already undergoing or having completed apprenticeship should not apply.
  • Applicants must select only one cluster.
  • The selected units must offer training slots for the applicant's ITI trade.
  • Selection is based on the simple average of Class 10 and ITI marks.
  • No separate written examination is prescribed.
  • Merit lists are prepared cluster-wise, unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise.
  • SC/ST/PwBD and women candidates are exempt from the application fee.
  • The notified monthly stipend is Rs. 9,600.
  • The apprenticeship training duration is one year.
  • Selected candidates must arrange their own accommodation.
  • Original document verification and medical fitness are mandatory.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending document verification.
  • Apprenticeship completion does not guarantee regular railway employment.
  • Candidates should regularly check the official RRC Central Railway website for updates.

Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must hold a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government. Graduation must have been completed within the period specified by the bank.

Indian Bank Apprentice Educational Qualification

Requirement Details
Minimum Qualification Graduation in Any Discipline

Earliest Eligible Graduation Date 1 April 2022
Latest Eligible Graduation Date 1 November 2026
Final Result Declaration Deadline 1 November 2026

Important Graduation Year Restriction: Candidates who completed graduation before 1 April 2022 are not eligible. Candidates whose graduation results were declared after 1 November 2026 are also not eligible.

Can Graduates from 2021 Apply?

No. Candidates who passed graduation before 1 April 2022 do not satisfy the passing-date requirement under the FY 2026-27 apprenticeship notification.

Can Final-Year Students Apply?

Only candidates whose final graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026 meet the notified qualification cut-off. Candidates awaiting their final result after that date are not eligible.

Previous Apprenticeship and Work Experience Restrictions

The bank does not permit applications from candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, are currently undergoing apprenticeship training or had their apprenticeship terminated due to their own fault.

Candidates who have accumulated one year or more of work experience after completing their educational qualification are also ineligible.

Indian Bank Apprentice Age Limit 2026

The age limit for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 20 to 28 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation for eligible categories.

Age Criteria Details
Minimum Age 20 Years
Maximum Age 28 Years
Age Calculation Date 1 November 2026
Earliest Date of Birth (General / EWS) 2 November 1998

Age relaxation is subject to the conditions and supporting certificate requirements specified in the advertisement. Candidates must not automatically combine multiple relaxations unless permitted.

Indian Bank Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 in Metro/Urban branches or Rs. 12,300 in Rural/Semi-Urban branches during the 12-month training period.

Stipend Clarification: The stipend is not a regular bank employee salary. Apprentices are not eligible for additional allowances or regular employee benefits under this engagement.

Indian Bank Apprentice Training Duration 2026

The apprenticeship duration is 12 months of on-the-job training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

Particulars Details
Training Period 12 Months
Training Type On-the-Job Training

Indian Bank Apprentice Leave and Certification Rules

Apprentices are entitled to bank holidays and one casual leave after completing each month of training. A maximum of four casual leaves may be taken at one time.

The notification requires more than 338 paid days during the 12-month period to become eligible for the Certificate of Proficiency, subject to the prescribed assessment and completion conditions.

After successful training and assessment, the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will issue a digital Certificate of Proficiency through NATS 2.0.

Is Indian Bank Apprenticeship a Permanent Job?

No. Apprenticeship is a fixed-duration training arrangement. Indian Bank has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment after completion of training, and apprentices do not have a right to claim employment with the bank.

Indian Bank Apprentice Application Fee 2026

The application fee is Rs. 800 plus GST for General, OBC and EWS candidates. SC, ST and PwBD candidates must pay Rs. 175 plus GST.

Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking using the available payment gateway.

The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable bank transaction charges are additional.

Indian Bank Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The selection procedure includes an online objective examination and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT). Indian Bank may also conduct an interview at its discretion.

  1. NATS Registration: Eligible candidates complete their apprenticeship registration and profile.
  2. Online Application: Candidates submit the application and pay the applicable fee.
  3. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the 100-mark objective examination.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test: Qualified candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the selected State/UT language unless exempt.
  5. Interview, If Conducted: The bank may include or dispense with an interview.
  6. Merit List: Candidates are ranked according to the applicable State/UT and category-wise merit rules.
  7. Document Verification: Eligibility and supporting certificates are verified.
  8. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to the bank's prescribed medical fitness requirements.
  9. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates receive their digital engagement through NATS 2.0.

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online examination consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks, with a composite duration of 60 minutes.

Total 100 100

Exam Mode Online

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Qualifying Marks

Indian Bank will determine the minimum qualifying marks on the aggregate examination score. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for individual sections.

SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates receive a 5% relaxation in the prescribed aggregate qualifying percentage.

How Is the Indian Bank Apprentice Merit List Prepared?

The bank will prepare merit lists State/UT-wise and category-wise according to online examination performance.

Candidates will be ranked in descending order of aggregate marks. If candidates have identical marks at the cut-off, the older candidate will receive preference.

Where examinations are conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized using the equi-percentile method.

A State/UT-wise and category-wise waiting list may also be prepared to fill unoccupied apprenticeship seats.

Indian Bank Apprentice Local Language Test 2026

Candidates must be able to read, write, speak and understand one of the specified local languages of their selected State or Union Territory.

The Local Language Proficiency Test will be conducted after the online examination. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices.

Who Is Exempt from the Indian Bank Local Language Test?

Candidates who provide Class 8, Class 10 or Class 12 marksheets or certificates proving they studied their selected local language are exempt from appearing in the Local Language Proficiency Test.

Important: Candidates without the prescribed language-study evidence must qualify in the LLPT. The test will be held at a centre decided by the bank in the relevant State/UT, and candidates must bear their own travel expenses.

Indian Bank Apprentice State and District Preference 2026

Applicants can apply for only one State or Union Territory. During registration, candidates may choose three preferred districts within the selected State/UT.

The bank gives the applicant's resident district the first preference in the applicable merit arrangement, while candidates may select two additional neighbouring districts.

Important: District preferences do not guarantee posting in a particular branch or district. Indian Bank may allot candidates to any district within their selected State/UT according to availability and operational requirements.

Eligible candidates can apply for the 1,500 Indian Bank apprenticeship training seats from 5 November to 25 November 2026.

Apply Online: Click Here

Application Last Date: 25 November 2026.

Important: Candidates must complete their NATS profile fully and submit the Indian Bank apprenticeship application. Merely registering on NATS without completing the recruitment-specific application is not sufficient.

How to Apply Online for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

Step 1 - Register on NATS 2.0

  1. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Open the Student Registration facility.
  3. Complete the enrolment process using the information requested on the portal.
  4. Enter accurate personal, contact and educational qualification details.
  5. Provide graduation passing information and other required certificates.
  6. Complete all mandatory profile sections until the NATS profile shows 100% completion.
  7. Save the generated NATS Enrolment ID.

Step 2 - Apply for Indian Bank Apprenticeship 2026

  1. Visit Indian Bank Careers or the NATS portal.
  2. Locate the recruitment titled Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank - 2026.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and verify the qualification, graduation passing date, age and experience restrictions.
  4. Open the corresponding online application facility.
  5. Click New Registration if registering for the recruitment for the first time.
  6. Enter your name, contact details and email address.
  7. Note the provisional registration number and password.
  8. Use the Save and Next facility while completing the application.
  9. Enter the required personal, address, graduation and category details.
  10. Select one eligible State/UT.
  11. Choose the preferred districts within that State/UT.
  12. Select one of the prescribed local languages for the language proficiency requirement.
  13. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  14. Complete the additional details requested by the application form.
  15. Open the Preview tab and carefully verify all entered information.
  16. Select Complete Registration after confirming the details.
  17. Pay the applicable fee through the online payment facility.
  18. Complete the application by 25 November 2026.
  19. Save the application printout and payment confirmation for future reference.

Important: Once the application is finally submitted, changes to the submitted details will not be permitted. Candidates should ensure that their name, date of birth and educational details match their official certificates.

Documents Required for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following documents and records available for registration, application and subsequent verification, as applicable.

  • Graduation degree certificate and marksheets.
  • Proof showing the graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026.
  • Date-of-birth proof.
  • Valid identity proof.
  • NATS 2.0 Enrolment ID.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph.
  • Scanned signature.
  • Left thumb impression.
  • Handwritten declaration.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS category certificate, if applicable.
  • PwBD disability certificate or UDID card, where applicable.
  • Class 8, 10 or 12 certificate showing study of the selected local language, if claiming LLPT exemption.
  • Other applicable documents requested by the bank during verification.

Documents must be uploaded in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format. Candidates must also capture a live photograph through a webcam or mobile phone using the application portal's facility.

Indian Bank Apprentice Handwritten Declaration 2026

The handwritten declaration must be written in English on white paper using black ink. It must be written in the candidate's own handwriting and must not be written entirely in capital letters.

The official declaration is:

I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.

Candidates should reproduce the declaration exactly as prescribed in Annexure II of the official notification.

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Centres 2026

The online examination will be conducted at various centres across India. The tentative examination centre list is provided in Annexure I of the official advertisement.

Candidates can indicate their preferred examination centre while applying, subject to the options provided by the application form. However, Indian Bank may allot a different centre according to availability.

Requests for examination centre changes will not be entertained. Candidates must bear their own examination-related travel expenses.

Indian Bank Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Indian Bank will issue examination call letters through its official website or other recruitment-related portals identified in the notification.

Candidates must download their call letters using the registration number or roll number and the required login credentials.

Call letters will not be sent by post. Applicants should regularly check their registered email and the official bank recruitment website for examination updates.

Indian Bank Apprentice Certificate and Contract Conditions

Selected candidates will receive a digital apprenticeship engagement offer through NATS 2.0. The apprenticeship contract is normally for 12 months and terminates automatically after completion of the prescribed training period.

Candidates must report at the allotted bank branch or training venue on the specified joining date. Failure to report may lead to termination of the apprenticeship contract.

Early Termination of Apprenticeship

The advertisement specifies conditions for early termination of the apprenticeship contract, including voluntary withdrawal, misconduct, employment elsewhere and medical inability to continue training.

A candidate who voluntarily leaves the training before completing the contract may be required to pay an amount equivalent to one month's stipend, under the notified conditions.

Separate provisions apply to termination after securing gainful employment or due to medical grounds. Candidates should read the full contractual conditions before accepting the apprenticeship.

Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Indian Bank has announced 1,500 apprenticeship training seats for FY 2026-27.
  • Online applications are open from 5 November to 25 November 2026.
  • Graduation in any discipline is required.
  • Graduation must have been completed between 1 April 2022 and 1 November 2026.
  • The age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation.
  • Candidates with one year or more of post-qualification work experience are not eligible.
  • Applicants who have already undergone apprenticeship training are ineligible.
  • Only one State/UT can be selected.
  • Candidates must maintain a fully completed NATS 2.0 profile.
  • The application fee is Rs. 800 or Rs. 175 plus GST, depending on category.
  • Selection includes a 100-mark online test and Local Language Proficiency Test.
  • The bank may conduct an interview at its discretion.
  • Local language exemption is available with the prescribed school-study evidence.
  • The stipend depends on whether the allotted branch is Metro/Urban or Rural/Semi-Urban.
  • Training lasts for 12 months.
  • Apprenticeship does not guarantee regular or contractual employment.
  • Ex-Servicemen and Disabled Ex-Servicemen are not eligible under the notification.
  • Candidates must satisfy document verification and medical fitness requirements.
  • The bank may revise the training seats, selection requirements or schedule through official updates.

Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized institution or university, have two years of qualifying work experience and meet the prescribed typing and computer requirements.

The selection process consists of a Preliminary Test, Main Examination and qualifying Skill Test. The Preliminary Test is used for shortlisting, while the Main Examination determines merit, subject to qualification in the Skill Test.

  2. Main Examination - Descriptive examination.
  3. Skill Test - Computer proficiency, office procedures, noting, drafting and typing.
  4. Document Verification - Verification of qualification, experience and other eligibility claims.
  5. Final Merit - Based on Main Examination marks, subject to applicable selection rules.

Preliminary Examination Shortlisting Rules

The qualifying cut-off is determined using 50% of the average score of the top 5% of candidates appearing in the test, subject to the special calculation provisions in the notification.

The notification provides a five-percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST candidates and a ten-percentage-point relaxation for PwBD candidates in the prescribed cut-off.

For shortlisting to the Main Examination, the University prescribes 30 candidates for one vacancy and 15 additional candidates for each further vacancy, subject to merit and ties at the cut-off.

Candidates must pay the prescribed application and processing fees through the online payment facility.

The selection process varies according to the discipline. The official notification specifies separate procedures for Legal posts and other executive positions.

Selection Process for Legal Posts

Selection for Deputy Manager (Legal) will be based on a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Personal Interview.

  • Computer Based Test: 80 Marks
  • Personal Interview: 20 Marks

  • Interview shortlisting ratio: 1:6, subject to the notification

Selection Process for Other Executive Posts

For disciplines other than Legal, selection will be based on a Personal Interview. If the number of eligible applicants exceeds the prescribed shortlisting ratio, NLC India Limited may conduct a Screening Test through CBT before the interview.

The minimum qualifying marks in the Personal Interview are 50% for UR / EWS candidates and 40% for SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / PwBD candidates against applicable reserved posts. Candidates must also satisfy document verification and medical fitness requirements.

The circular is issued by the Office of the Regional Executive Director, Airports Authority of India, Eastern Region, located at N.S.C.B.I. Airport, Kolkata - 700052. It is addressed to the Airport Directors at Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Bagdogra, Cooch Behar, Deoghar, Darbhanga, Gaya, Jharsuguda, Pakyong, Patna, Port Blair, Raipur and Ranchi, and to the Officers-In-Charge at Katihar, Behala, Berhampur, Durgapur and Jamshedpur. Applications are invited from eligible and willing departmental candidates from the Eastern Region who possess the requisite qualifications and experience under the R&P Regulations, 2020 and the subsequent circulars and amendments. How to Apply for AAI Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6)

  1. Fill in the enclosed proforma, "Application for the post of Sr Assistant (Ops) (NE-6), Departmental Examination - 2026". It asks for your full name in block letters as per the Service Book, father's name, designation, employee number, date of birth, community (ST/UR), date of appointment in CAD/NAA/IAAI/AAI, present scale of pay and basic pay, educational and other qualifications, date of joining or promotion in the present grade, present station of posting, experience in the relevant field, and willingness to transfer to any station under ER.
  2. Sign the Declaration and Undertaking stating that the information you have furnished is true and correct.
  3. Submit the application "Through Proper Channel" at your airport or station.
  4. The HOD HR of the establishment or station verifies all particulars in the proforma (date of birth, caste, educational qualifications and so on) from your service record. The HOD HR then signs the certificate with name, designation and office seal, confirming that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated against you.
  5. The application, with self-attested copies of the documents listed below, is forwarded by email to [email protected] positively on or before 30 November 2026.

  • Self-attested caste certificate. The proforma asks for a copy for ST candidates.
  • Documents supporting experience in the relevant field, such as an office order or an experience certificate issued by the APDs, the Officer in charge or the HoD of the concerned station or department
  • PAR grading for the preceding 5 years up to 2025-2026
  • Certificate from the HOD HR that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated

Selection and Interview

The 23 vacancies will be filled through a Departmental Examination for the Eastern Region. Only applications of eligible departmental candidates that the concerned Airport, Station or RHQ forwards through proper channel within the stipulated time will be considered for the further selection process.   • The Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Kolkata.

  • For enquiries, the RHQ Eastern Region office at N.S.C.B.I. Airport, Kolkata can be reached on Phone (033) 25119600 or Fax (033) 25110360.

Eligible Indian male candidates with Class 10, Class 12, ITI, Diploma or relevant degree qualifications can apply according to the trade-specific requirements. The age limit is generally 18 to 23 years or 18 to 25 years, depending on the post, with applicable relaxation. The online application process starts on 15 November 2026, and candidates can apply through assamrifles.gov.in until 14 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 is tentatively scheduled to begin on 18 January 2027. Selection includes a Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade Skill Test, Document Verification and Medical Examination. Candidates must possess the prescribed domicile or permanent residential certificate and satisfy the trade-specific eligibility conditions before submitting their applications.

Educational qualifications vary depending on the trade. Candidates must possess the prescribed academic, technical or professional qualification from a recognized board, university or institute.

Can 10th Pass Candidates Apply for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Class 10 pass candidates can apply for certain posts, including Rifleman (Armourer) and Rifleman (Mason). Other trades require additional ITI certificates or specified school subjects.

Can 12th Pass Candidates Apply?

Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 12 can apply for eligible positions such as Warrant Officer (Cipher), Havildar (Instrument Repairer/Mechanic), Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist, provided they possess the additional trade-specific qualifications.

Can ITI Certificate Holders Apply?

Yes. Several technical trades require ITI qualifications, including Electrician, Motor Mechanic, Welder, Metalsmith, Upholster, Engineer Equipment Mechanic and Recovery Vehicle Mechanic.

The applicant's ITI trade must correspond to the qualification specified for the selected post.

Is Domicile Certificate Mandatory?

Yes. Candidates must possess a valid Domicile or Permanent Residential Certificate issued by the competent authority.

The notification states that candidates must enter the correct domicile State/UT while applying. They will not be allowed to change that State during document verification.

Applicants using bank-counter payment must upload a copy of the payment challan or receipt while completing the online application and produce the original during the recruitment rally.

The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against another recruitment expense.

Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process includes physical fitness, academic and technical assessments, document verification and medical examination.

  1. Online Application Submission.
  2. RFID-Based Physical Standard Test (PST).
  3. Physical Efficiency Test (PET).
  4. Initial Document Verification.
  5. Computer Based Test (CBT).
  6. Trade Skill Test.
  7. Detailed Document Verification.
  8. Detailed Medical Examination (DME).
  9. Review Medical Examination (RME), Where Applicable.
  10. Final Merit List and Training Call.

Important: Candidates must qualify at each applicable stage to remain eligible for further consideration. Merely passing the physical tests or CBT does not guarantee selection.

Assam Rifles Physical Standard Test (PST) 2026

The physical standards depend on the candidate's category and the applicable regional relaxation.

Weight must be proportionate to height and age according to the applicable medical standards.

Important: Candidates claiming relaxed physical measurements must produce the appropriate supporting certificates.

Assam Rifles Physical Efficiency Test (PET) 2026

Male candidates who qualify the initial physical and document checks must complete the prescribed running test.

Assam Rifles Recruitment Rally Centres

The exact reporting date and further instructions will be published through the official Assam Rifles website.

Meeting the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee shortlisting for the Trade Skill Test. Candidates are shortlisted according to their merit in CBT and the number of vacancies in their respective trades and categories.

Assam Rifles Trade Skill Test 2026

The Trade Skill Test assesses the practical skills required for the selected technical or tradesman position.

The notification specifies that the Trade Skill Test consists of a Computer-Based Practical Skill Test and a Trade-Specific Practical Skill Test, as applicable.

The test is qualifying in nature, and no marks are awarded for the Trade Skill Test in the final merit calculation.

How Are Candidates Shortlisted for the Trade Skill Test?

Shortlisting is based on CBT merit in the relevant trade and category. Candidates who qualify the Trade Skill Test proceed to the applicable document verification and medical examination.

The notification specifies shortlisting of approximately four candidates per vacancy for the subsequent document verification and medical assessment process, subject to the applicable trade and category provisions.

Assam Rifles Medical Examination 2026

Candidates qualifying in the recruitment stages must undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME).

Medical examinations will be conducted according to the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination prescribed for Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles.

Where permitted, candidates declared unfit may undergo a Review Medical Examination (RME) under the relevant medical procedures.

Important: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed medical requirements. Passing the written examination and Trade Skill Test does not remove the medical-fitness requirement.

Assam Rifles Salary 2026

Selected candidates will receive pay and allowances according to the applicable salary structure for Assam Rifles personnel.

The uploaded recruitment notice states that the pay scale and allowances will be admissible according to the pay scales applicable to Assam Rifles personnel. It does not provide a separate numerical pay matrix for each advertised trade.

Salary Note: Applicants should not assume that Warrant Officer, Havildar and Rifleman posts have identical pay. Exact basic pay, allowances and service benefits depend on the applicable rank and appointment rules.

Eligible candidates can apply online through the official Assam Rifles recruitment website from 15 November to 14 December 2026.

Only one application per candidate is permitted, and applications must be submitted online.

How to Apply Online for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026?

  2. Open the Online Application section.
  3. Find Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026.
  4. Read the recruitment notification and eligibility conditions.
  5. Select the appropriate trade.
  6. Enter the required personal details.
  7. Provide the correct name and date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation certificate.
  8. Enter the prescribed domicile State/UT information.

  10. Enter a valid mobile number and email address.
  11. Fill in the reservation and category information, where applicable.
  12. Upload any required documents as instructed by the portal.
  13. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 if not exempted.
  14. If using the prescribed SBI bank-counter payment method, upload the required challan/receipt.
  15. Review the entire application carefully.
  16. Complete the online application submission before 14 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

  18. Save the payment receipt and application confirmation.
  19. Keep the printed application and required original documents ready for the recruitment rally.

Important: The notification states that corrections or modifications will not be permitted after online submission. Candidates must verify their chosen trade, State/UT, category and personal details before submitting the form.

Documents Required for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following documents ready for online application and subsequent recruitment rally verification, as applicable.
