SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 Download Link

Candidates can check their SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam City 2026 through the official Staff Selection Commission candidate login portal. The exam city intimation facility provides advance information about the allotted examination city and scheduled examination date.

Candidates should log in using their SSC Registration Number and Password to check the examination city information. The city slip is not a substitute for the admit card, which will be issued separately.

SSC CPO Exam City Link: Check Exam City Intimation Slip 2026

How to Download SSC CPO Exam City Slip 2026?

Candidates can check their SSC CPO examination city by following these steps.

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the Login or Register option.
  3. Enter your Registration Number and Password.
  4. Log in to the SSC candidate dashboard.
  5. Find the SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam City Intimation 2026 option.
  6. Click on the examination city details link when available.
  7. Check the allotted examination city, date and shift information.
  8. Download or save the displayed details for future reference.

SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam Date 2026

The Staff Selection Commission will conduct the SSC CPO Paper 1 examination from 23 November to 28 November 2026. The examination will be held in CBT mode at designated examination centres.

Candidates should check their allotted exam date and city through the official candidate portal. The complete examination centre address and reporting instructions will be provided on the admit card.

SSC CPO Admit Card 2026

The SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 is expected to become available from 20 November 2026 onwards. Candidates will need to download the admit card separately before appearing for the examination.

The admit card will contain the examination centre address, exam date, reporting time and important examination instructions.

  • Allotted examination city

  • Shift or examination timing, if provided

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), in Advertisement No. 13/2026, invites online applications for 13 vacancies in four posts: Dental Surgeon (5, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare), Ayurveda Physician (2) and Homeopathic Physician (1) (both New Delhi Municipal Council), and Scientist 'B' (5, Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change). All four posts are at Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Candidates are shortlisted for interview, with a Recruitment Test if held. Applications are taken on upsconline.nic.in from 14 November 2026 until 1800 hrs on 04 December 2026, and eligibility is fixed on that closing date.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

This is a recruitment by selection to four Group A Gazetted, Non-Ministerial posts under the Central Government and the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post was advertised earlier and is re-advertised with changed PwBD suitability.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation Union Public Service Commission
Recruitment Name Recruitment by selection, Advertisement No. 13/2026
Advertisement No. 13/2026
Notification Date 14-11-2026
Post Names Dental Surgeon; Ayurveda Physician; Homeopathic Physician; Scientist 'B'
Total Vacancies 13
Departments Department of Health & Family Welfare; New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC); Botanical Survey of India
Qualification Varies by post: BDS, Ayurveda degree, Homoeopathy degree or Master's Degree in Botany/Horticulture/Chemistry (Organic)
Age Limit Varies by post
Pay Level or Pay Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (plus NPA for Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician)
Application Fee Rs. 25/- (no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women)
Application Mode Online at https://upsconline.nic.in
Application Dates 14-11-2026 to 04-12-2026 (1800 hrs)
Selection Process Shortlisting, Recruitment Test (if held), interview
Job Location Anywhere in India (Dental Surgeon); New Delhi (NDMC posts); Kolkata (Scientist 'B')
Official Website https://upsconline.nic.in

The official notification does not specify the Recruitment Test pattern or the interview date.

About UPSC Recruitment 2026

The Union Public Service Commission invites these applications through its online recruitment application portal. The Dental Surgeon post serves in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh. The Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts are in the AYUSH Cadre of the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post is at the Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, Salt Lake City, Kolkata.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement published / online applications start 14-11-2026
Last date for online applications 04-12-2026, 1800 hrs
Date for age and similar eligibility conditions, Scientist 'B' only (original closing date) 03-07-2026
Interview date To be intimated separately

Applications start on 14 November 2026. The date for determining the eligibility of all candidates in every respect is the closing date for online applications. For Scientist 'B', the notice says the original closing date, 03.07.2026, prevails for age and similar eligibility conditions.

UPSC Vacancy 2026

The notice carries 13 vacancies in total: 5 + 2 + 1 + 5.

Post Vacancy No. Organisation Pay Level Vacancies
Dental Surgeon 26111301114 Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare Level 10 5
Ayurveda Physician 26111302114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 2
Homeopathic Physician 26111303114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 1
Scientist 'B' 26111304214 Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change Level 10 5
Total 13

UPSC Category-wise Vacancy 2026

Post UR EWS OBC SC Total
Dental Surgeon 3 1 - 1 5
Ayurveda Physician 1 1 - - 2
Homeopathic Physician - 1 - - 1
Scientist 'B' 2 1 1 1 5

Of the five Dental Surgeon vacancies, one is reserved for persons with benchmark disability (PwBD) in the Deaf and Hard of Hearing category. Ayurveda Physician, Homeopathic Physician and Scientist 'B' are not reserved for PwBD but are identified as suitable for certain disability types. The disability-type suitability tables for each post are in the official notification.

The five Scientist 'B' vacancies may be filled by candidates with these disciplines: MSc Botany - 3; MSc Horticulture - 1; MSc Chemistry (Organic) - 1.

UPSC Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Qualification Required
Dental Surgeon A recognised Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree included in part-1 of the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948), or one of the alternatives listed below; registration with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India; completion of CRI.
Ayurveda Physician Degree in Ayurveda of a recognized University/Statutory State Board/Council/Faculty of Indian Systems of Medicine recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act 1970 (48 of 1970); enrolment on the Centre or a State Register for Indian Medicine.
Homeopathic Physician Degree in Homoeopathy of a Recognised University/Statutory State Board/Council or equivalent recognised under the Homoeopathic Central Council Act, 1973 (59 of 1973); enrolment on the Central Register of Homoeopathy or State Register of Homoeopathy.
Scientist 'B' Master's Degree in Botany or Horticulture or Chemistry (Organic) from a recognised University or Institute. Desirable: Doctorate in the same subjects.

Dental Surgeon: alternative qualifications

  • A recognised Dental qualification obtained upto 01.11.1972 under Part-II of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • OR a recognised Dental qualification granted by an authority or institution outside India, only when granted to a citizen of India upto 13.08.2009 under Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948.
  • OR a citizen of India with a foreign qualification who has appeared and passed the Screening Test Examination as per Screening Test Regulation 2009 w.e.f. 13.08.2009.
  • Candidates who have not completed CRI (compulsory rotating internship) may appear for selection, but if selected must complete it satisfactorily before appointment.

Other conditions

  • Citizenship: a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from the countries named in the notice. The last three groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.
  • Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC, for reasons to be recorded in writing, for candidates otherwise well qualified.
  • Where enough eligible PwBD candidates are not available for posts reserved or identified suitable for them, the experience qualification may be relaxed up to 50 per cent. The notice prints no experience requirement for these four posts.
  • Candidature at all stages is provisional, subject to satisfying the eligibility conditions.

Candidates should read the official notification for the disability-specific suitability of each post.

UPSC Age Limit 2026

The age limit differs by post. The age limit shown is the normal limit for EWS/UR candidates and the relaxed limit for SC/OBC candidates where printed. The age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. The notice sets the closing date for online applications as the date for determining eligibility; for Scientist 'B' age and similar conditions, the original closing date 03.07.2026 prevails.

Post Age Limit
Dental Surgeon 35 years for UR, 35 years for EWS, and 40 years for SC
Ayurveda Physician 35 years for UR and 35 years for EWS
Homeopathic Physician 35 years for EWS
Scientist 'B' 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC

Age Relaxation

Category Relaxation
SC/ST/OBC/PwBD (vacancies reserved for them) Up to five years for SC/ST, up to three years for OBC, up to ten years for PwBD
PwBD 10 years in the upper age limit for posts identified suitable for the disability (SC/ST get maximum 15 years including 5 years for their category; OBC maximum up to 13 years); applicant's maximum age on the closing date must not exceed 56 years; minimum 40% disability
Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers including ECOs/SSCOs Five years, if continuous service in the Armed Forces on the closing date is not less than six months after attestation (ECO/SSCO conditions apply as printed)
Central/UT Government servants Up to 5 years (10 years for SC/ST and 8 years for OBC in respect of posts reserved for them), with 3 years continuous service in Central Government in the same line or an allied cadre; decision rests with the Commission

UPSC Salary 2026

Post Pay Level Pay Scale
Dental Surgeon Level 10 Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Ayurveda Physician Level 10 plus NPA Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Homeopathic Physician Level 10 plus NPA Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Scientist 'B' Level 10 Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC

For the Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts, private practice of any kind is prohibited, for which non-practicing allowance (NPA) is allowed. The notice prints no rupee amount.

UPSC Application Fee 2026

Category Fee
Candidates other than Female/SC/ST/PwBD (OBC, EWS and Unreserved male candidates pay the full fee) Rs. 25/- (Rupees Twenty five)
SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates of any community No fee

The fee is paid by Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment or by internet banking of any Bank, and the payment mode must be opted for up to the closing date/time. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected, and no representation is entertained. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance and cannot be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

UPSC Selection Process 2026

Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of the information in their online applications and their performance in the Recruitment Test (RT), if held. The stages in order are:

  1. Shortlisting based on the online application, with a Recruitment Test if held.
  2. Interview.
  • If applications are large, the Commission may restrict the number called for interview by desirable qualification, higher qualification, higher experience, counting experience before or after the essential qualification, invoking experience even where none is prescribed, or by holding a Recruitment Test.
  • Minimum suitability in the interview, out of 100 marks: UR-50, OBC-45, SC/ST/PH-40.
  • Where an RT is followed by an interview, a candidate must reach the minimum suitability for the category at both stages. The RT minimum is decided by the Commission case to case.
  • The date of the interview, for which shortlisted candidates bring the print-out of the online application and other documents, will be intimated separately.
  • If a Recruitment Test forms part of selection, it will ordinarily be held at Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi and Visakhapatnam. The list is subject to change.

UPSC Job Description 2026

Dental Surgeon

  • Looks after OPD and indoor patients in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh.
  • Medical attendance with treatment of Central Government employees, members of their families, Central Government Pensioners and other beneficiaries covered by the Central Government Health Scheme.
  • Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

Ayurveda Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Ayurveda Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Homeopathic Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Homoeopathy Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Scientist 'B'

  • To undertake research on floristic / taxonomic revisions.
  • To identify plants.
  • To prepare proper scientific reports on field or herbarium specimens.
  • To undertake field excursions.
  • To supervise the work of Scientific Asstt. & Technical Asstt.

How to Apply Online for UPSC Recruitment 2026

  1. Go to the Commission's website https://upsconline.nic.in and read the General instructions, Profile/Module-wise instructions and instructions for uploading documents on the menu bar of the home page.
  2. Register on the portal to get a Universal Registration Number (URN), giving the details of one Photo ID Card (Aadhaar is strongly advised) in the URN profile.
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF), uploading a photograph and capturing a live photograph, and uploading three signatures made one below the other in black ink on plain white paper.
  4. Fill the post/vacancy-specific module for the advertised post and upload, in pdf, the documents supporting each claim (date of birth, category, disability, qualification, experience, age relaxation).
  5. Pay the fee of Rs. 25/- by card, UPI or net banking if not exempted.
  6. Submit the application by 1800 hrs on 04-12-2026 and take a print-out of the finally submitted application. An Application Number is generated; keep it with the URN for communication.
  • Failure to provide the required information/documents along with the CAF cancels candidature for the post.
  • Candidates are not required to send printouts or documents by post or by hand. They bring them if called for interview.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the closing date.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth.
  • Degree/Diploma certificate; if unavailable, a provisional certificate with mark sheets for all academic years.
  • Order/letter on equivalent qualification, if one is claimed as equivalent.
  • Experience certificate in the prescribed proforma from the Head of Organisation, where claimed. Pay slips, resumes, appointment letters, relieving letters and unsigned experience certificates must not be uploaded in the Document Upload Module.
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma for SC/ST/OBC; OBC candidates also a declaration of non-creamy layer status.
  • Certificate of Disability in the prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates.
  • Age relaxation certificates for Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers, or Central/UT Government employees (issued after the date of advertisement).
  • Name-change documents, if the name has changed after matriculation.
  • Certificates for professional registration, language, publications, NET, GATE, conference and internship claims, where made.

Documents in a language other than Hindi or English need a transcript attested by a Gazetted officer or notary.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Scientist 'B' was advertised on 13.06.2026 as Advertisement No. 06/2026 (Vacancy No. 26060683213, closing date 03.07.2026) and is re-advertised under Advertisement No. 13/2026 with changed PwBD suitability.
  • Scientist 'B' vacancies are now identified as suitable for PwBD candidates in the Hard of Hearing (HH), Specific Learning Disability (SLD), Mental Illness (MI) and Multiple Disability (MD) categories. These were not identified earlier.
  • Candidates who already applied against Advertisement No. 06/2026 need not apply again. They may edit their existing applications. If they retain them unchanged, the data is preserved and merged with the new advertisement.
  • Applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction is allowed in the application form after submission.
  • The URN profile has a one-time edit facility. Changes do not affect applications already submitted.
  • All correspondence is by e-mail only, so candidates must give a correct and active e-mail address. The interview schedule is e-mailed and posted on the Commission's website.
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview must send self-attested copies of documents as and when demanded. At the interview they must bring the print-out and the original documents. Failure to present them disqualifies the candidate and bars reimbursement of travelling expenses.
  • False information may lead to rejection and debarment from UPSC examinations or Central Government employment, permanently or for a specified period.
  • Dental Surgeon: all vacancies are permanent but are filled on temporary basis. Appointees are confirmed after probation of one year.
  • Scientist 'B' probation is two years, and a mandatory induction training of at least two weeks is needed for successful completion.
  • Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician: probation is one year.
  • Persons in regular Government service must declare that they have informed their Head of Office in writing about applying.

SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE Eligibility Criteria 2026

The SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026 is restricted to eligible departmental candidates serving in the participating services and cadres. The required length of approved service and other conditions vary by cadre.

The Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India, invites applications from distinguished academicians with a minimum of 10 years' experience as Professor in a University or 10 years' experience in a reputed research and/or academic administrative organization. Applications are accepted online only on the Ministry of Education SAMARTH portal from 16 November 2026, 10:00 hours to 15 December 2026, 17:00 hours.

About the Recruitment

The notice is issued by the Department of Higher Education under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, for the appointment of the Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University. The notice describes the Vice-Chancellor as the academic as well as administrative head of the University. The advertisement is printed in English and Hindi, and both versions carry the same details.

Who Can Apply

The notice lists what the Vice-Chancellor is expected to be:

  • A person possessing the highest level of competence, integrity, morals and institutional commitment.
  • A distinguished academician, with a minimum of 10 years' experience as Professor in a University, or 10 years' experience in reputed research and/or academic administrative organization with proof of having demonstrated academic leadership.

The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the requirement is stated as academic standing and experience. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions.

Age Limit

The candidate should preferably be not more than 65 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of applications of this advertisement. The word "preferably" is used in the notice, and no age relaxation is mentioned.

Pay and Terms

  • Pay: Rs. 2,10,000/- (Fixed) per month.
  • Special Allowance: Rs. 11,250/-, along with other usual allowances.
  • Service terms: the terms and conditions of service will be those set forth in the Act, Statutes and Ordinances of the University.

The notice does not mention the tenure of the appointment; it is governed by the University's Act, Statutes and Ordinances.

How to Apply for JNU Vice-Chancellor

The notice states that candidates are required to "APPLY ONLINE ONLY". No paper or email application route is given.

  1. Go to the Ministry of Education SAMARTH portal at https://vcrec.samarth.ac.in/index.php/.
  2. Submit the online application for the post of Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University.
  3. Complete the application while the link is active: from 16.11.2026, 10:00 hours to 15.12.2026, 17:00 hours.

The advertisement is also available on the websites https://www.dohe-education.gov.in and https://www.jnu.ac.in. The notice does not list the documents to be uploaded.

Selection Process

The appointment of the Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University will be made from a panel of names recommended by a committee constituted under the provisions of the Act of the University. The notice does not describe further stages or give an interview date.

CSIR - National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi (under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research) invites applications from Indian citizens for 25 Multi Tasking Staff posts under Advertisement No. Rectt./05/2026. The prescribed form, downloaded from www.nplindia.in, goes by post to the Senior Controller of Administration, CSIR- National Physical Laboratory, Dr. K.S. Krishnan Marg, New Delhi-110012, and must reach on or before 23 December 2026. Late receipt is not entertained.

CSIR-NPL MULTI TASKING STAFF at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationCSIR - National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi
Advertisement No.Rectt./05/2026
Post(s)Multi Tasking Staff (Post Code MTS)
Vacancies25
PayLevel 1 (Rs.18,000-56,900); basic pay Rs.18,000/-; total emoluments Rs. 41040/- per month
QualificationMatriculation or equivalent pass
Age LimitNot less than 18 years and not exceeding 25 years (as on 23.12.2026)
Job LocationCSIR-NPL, New Delhi
Apply ByPost (hard copy of the application form)
Last Date23.12.2026 (last date of receipt of application form)

About CSIR-NPL

CSIR-National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi, is described in the notice as a premier laboratory under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research and as the National Metrology Institute (NMI) of India, created by an act of parliament. It has six scientific and technical divisions, among them the Physico-Mechanical Metrology Division and the Indian Standard Time Division. Its research groups work on areas such as quantum metrology, nano science, thin films, cryogenics and instrumentation.

Where and How to Send

Download the prescribed application form from the NPL website www.nplindia.in. Complete it and send it by post in an envelope superscribed “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MTS” to: Senior Controller of Administration, CSIR- National Physical Laboratory, Dr. K.S. Krishnan Marg, New Delhi-110012. The application must reach on or before 23 December 2026, and the same date applies to candidates from far-flung areas. Applications arriving after the closing date for any reason, such as wrongly addressed envelopes, delivery elsewhere or postal delay, are not entertained.

The application fee is Rs. 500/- (“if applicable”), paid by crossed Demand Draft or Pay Order drawn on any nationalized bank, valid for at least 3 months, in favour of “Director, National Physical Laboratory”, payable at New Delhi. Write the candidate’s name and the post code applied for (MTS) on the back of the Demand Draft. Candidates belonging to the SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Abroad/Transgender categories are exempted from the application fee. SC/ST candidates applying against unreserved posts also get the fee exemption. The fee is not refunded and cannot be held for any other recruitment.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The notice announces 25 Multi Tasking Staff posts. The category break-up is printed as follows, and the vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease at the time of final selection.

CategoryPosts
UR12
EWS3
OBC (NCL)6
ST4
Total25

Of the 25 posts, 1 post is reserved for PwBD category [b] and 1 post for PwBD category [c]. In addition, 3 posts are reserved for Ex-serviceman. The notice prints no vacancies for SC.

  • Qualification: essential is Matriculation or equivalent pass; desirable is Intermediate (12th Class) pass. Results must be declared on or before the last date of application, and the qualification must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by Govt. of India or approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies.
  • Age: not less than 18 years and not exceeding 25 years, counted as on 23.12.2026.
  • Pay: Level 1 (Rs.18,000-56,900), basic pay Rs.18,000/-, total emoluments Rs. 41040/- per month. Total emoluments are approximate, on the minimum of the scale, including House Rent Allowance in a Class ‘X’ city.
  • Nationality: the applicant must be a citizen of India.

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST: 5 years and OBC (NCL): 3 years, only where the posts are reserved for these categories. SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age relaxation.
  • PwBD: 10 years for Unreserved candidates (15 years in total for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC), with a disability of not less than 40%, provided the post is identified suitable for the relevant category of disability.
  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years, after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age on the last date of application.
  • The notice adds that other relaxations apply as per extant GoI/CSIR rules and that the listed relaxations are not exhaustive.

Allowances and Service Terms

The posts carry Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance and Transport Allowance as admissible to central government employees and applicable to CSIR. HRA is not admissible if Council or Government accommodation is used. New entrants are governed by the National Pension System or the extant pension system. Medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession and House Building Advance are admissible as per CSIR rules. Selected candidates are on probation for two years from taking over charge; the period may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Competent Authority, and confirmation follows as per extant rules. They may be transferred to any CSIR Lab or Institute anywhere in India and cannot apply for appointment elsewhere or in the Laboratory during probation.

CSIR-NPL MULTI TASKING STAFF Job Description

The notice lists the job requirements and nature of the job as:

  • Physical maintenance of records of the Section; general cleanliness and upkeep of the Section; carrying files and documents to other Sections.
  • Photocopying, sending FAX, etc.; delivering the Dak; opening and closing the Section; assisting in Research & Development activities.
  • Guest House work: maintenance of records, collection and remittance of Guest House charges, cleanliness and maintenance of rooms, attending to guests’ complaints, queries and requirements, dusting of furniture, and preparation and supply of Tea/Coffee to the guests.
  • Maintenance and upkeep of gardens and green spaces: planting, nurturing and caring for plants, mowing lawns, trimming hedges, weeding, clearing debris, watering, fertilizing and pest control.
  • Physical maintenance of records of the work area and stock entry.
  • Vehicle work: maintenance and upkeep of vehicles, scheduling maintenance and repairs, managing vehicle records and log books, allocation of duties, liaising with the office for vehicle bills, and processing Fast-tag and insurance renewal bills.
  • Performing driver duties if required, in which case the incumbent is eligible for honorarium as per Rules. If required, the incumbent may have to work shift duties, and any other work assigned by the Competent Authority.

Enclosures

The notice lists these documents to attach to the application form sent by post:

  • Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- as application fee wherever applicable, with name and post on the back.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph pasted on Part I of the form and signed across in full.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph pasted on Part II of the form, not signed across the photograph.
  • Self-attested photocopy of the Date of Birth certificate (SSC/Matriculation/10th/SSLC/HSC certificate or a Birth certificate issued by the appropriate government authority is accepted as age proof).
  • Self-attested photocopy of educational certificate(s) and/or mark sheet(s) supporting the essential qualification and any higher qualification; where CGPA/SGPA grades are awarded, a copy of the board’s conversion formula into percentage.
  • Self-attested photocopy of caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), if applicable; OBC (NCL) candidates must also furnish the Form of Declaration.
  • Self-attested photocopies of experience certificates, if any.
  • Self-attested photocopy of EWS / PwBD / Women seeking relaxation / Ex-Serviceman / Transgender certificate, if applicable, and other relevant documents, if any.

Selection Process

Selection has three steps: scrutiny of applications, a written examination and a final merit list.

Screening of Applications

A duly constituted Screening Committee scrutinises the applications, adopts its own criteria and shortlists candidates to be called for the written examination. Possessing the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called. Screening is prima facie, based on the documents and information furnished.

Written Examination

The competitive written examination is one paper with four subjects, OMR-based objective type multiple choice, at Class 10 standard. Questions are set in English and Hindi, except the questions on the English Language. The paper has 150 questions to be answered in 2 hours.

PartSubjectQuestionsMarks
One paperGeneral Intelligence2575 (three marks per correct answer)
One paperQuantitative Aptitude2575 (three marks per correct answer)
One paperGeneral Awareness50150 (three marks per correct answer)
One paperEnglish Language50150 (three marks per correct answer)

There is one negative mark for every wrong answer. The minimum threshold (cut-off) marks for each category will be notified on the CSIR-NPL website before the written examination. The notice prints no examination date.

Merit List and Tie Rules

The final merit list is prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination. If two or more candidates have equal aggregate marks, the order of preference is: lesser negative marks; older date of birth; earlier acquisition of the essential qualification; alphabetical order of first names.

Important Instructions

  • Applicants working in CSIR, Government Departments, Autonomous bodies, Universities, PSUs or Government Funded Research Agencies must apply through proper channel; otherwise candidature will not be considered. Their hard copy must reach on or before 23.12.2026.
  • Employees of Government Departments need an employer endorsement that they will be relieved within one month of receipt of the appointment orders, with vigilance clearance recorded. An advance copy may be submitted before the closing date.
  • Name, date of birth and parents’ names must be filled strictly as in the SSC/Matriculation/10th Standard/SSLC/HSC certificate. A change of name needs a Gazette Notification or affidavit.
  • Candidates must state whether any blood or close relative works in CSIR-NPL, CSIR or any other CSIR national lab, institute or unit.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) certificates must be in the prescribed format issued by the Competent Authority; OBC (NCL) candidates need a certificate under Government of India criteria. EWS claims need an Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format.
  • Documents in a language other than Hindi or English need a transcript attested by a Gazetted Officer or notary.
  • Incomplete applications (without photograph, application fee, testimonials or signature) are summarily rejected, and false or incorrect information can lead to cancellation, or removal from service after joining.
  • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. No interim enquiry or correspondence is entertained.
  • Updates, including shortlisted candidates for the written examination, will be displayed only on https://www.nplindia.in. The Director may cancel the advertisement or not fill the posts.
  • If the Hindi and English advertisements differ, the English advertisement is final.

Senior Research Fellow (NET/GATE Qualified) Or Senior Project Fellow (NET/GATE non-qualified) M.Sc., Zoology/Wildlife biology/Biodiversity with at least 65% marks or CGPA of 6.5 in 10-point scale with two years' experience in the data curation, data analysis, GIS, remote sensing and species distribution modelling with research publications Not more than 32 Years

Desirable

  • Junior posts: knowledge of sampling, data collection, taxonomy and ecology of arthropods.
  • Senior posts: proficiency in statistical GIS software for biodiversity data analysis and species distribution modelling.

Age Relaxation

SC / ST / OBC / Women / PD candidates get age relaxation as per Govt. of India norms. The general instructions mention SC/ST/OBC-Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)/Women/Physically Challenged applicants. The notice prints no date for counting age.

Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

Pay and Tenure

Post Pay
Junior Research Fellow (CSIR-UGC NET qualified) Rs. 37,000.00/- + HRA as per Govt. rules
Junior Project Fellow (non-NET/GATE qualified) Rs. 25000 + HRA per Govt. rules
Senior Research Fellow (CSIR-UGC NET qualified) Rs. 42,000.00/- + HRA per month as per Govt. rules
Senior Project Fellow (non-NET/GATE qualified) Rs. 28000 + HRA per Govt. rules

The assignment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. According to the general instructions, all positions are full-time. The initial appointment is for one year, with the possibility of reappointment based on performance in the field and laboratory.

ZSI Recruitment 2026 Job Description

Junior Research Fellow / Junior Project Fellow

  • Conduct novel research on long term ecological monitoring of arthropods in the LTEO sites across India in terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems using integrated approaches.
  • Work on community ecology, stream ecology, GIS and use of remotely sensed data, molecular studies, and responses to environmental stresses in the context of global change.
  • Location of work: (1) Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (2) Central India (3) Gujarat (4) Western Himalaya (5) Eastern Himalaya (6) Andaman Islands.

Senior Research Fellow / Senior Project Fellow

  • Maintain, curate and analyse data collected from LTEO sites using relevant statistical techniques and GIS.
  • Prepare scientific and technical reports and manuscripts.
  • Location of work: Chennai.

How to Apply for ZSI Recruitment 2026

  1. Fill in the application form printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice, writing the name of the post at the top. It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, experience, computer and GIS expertise, publications, three referees and any other information, followed by a declaration with signature and date.
  2. Affix a recent photograph on the form and self-attest it.
  3. Enclose the documents listed below, together with a No Objection Certificate from the present employer if employed.
  4. Convert the completed form, certificates and enclosures into a single PDF file.
  5. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026. The application is addressed to The Officer-in-Charge, Zoological Survey of India, Southern Regional Centre, #130, Santhome High Road, Chennai - 600 028.

The notice does not give a subject line for the email.

Documents named in the notice

  • Self-attested copies of certificates (School/College such as Transfer Certificate, Mark Sheet, Degree Certificates etc.).
  • Attested true copies of testimonials of educational qualifications, research experience and proof for date of birth, with copies of mark sheets of all examinations.
  • Copies of Address and Aadhar card proof.
  • Evidence documents for the experience listed in the form.
  • No Objection Certificate from present employer (if employed).

Selection and Interview

Candidates are shortlisted on the basis of their qualification and experience. Shortlisted candidates are informed through email / speed post to appear before an interview committee. The date and time of the interview are informed through mobile number / email. Original certificates must be produced for verification at the time of interview.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of advertisement 05.11.2026
Last date to apply (by email) 25 November 2026

Important Instructions

  • Applications received after the last date are summarily rejected.
  • Incomplete application forms are summarily rejected.
  • Canvassing will disqualify the applicant.
  • The Director, Zoological Survey of India reserves the right to reject any candidature for incomplete information or for any other reason.
  • Selected candidates are required to travel to different field locations for data collection.
  • A false or concealed detail found at any stage leads to cancellation of selection, as the form's declaration states.

How to Check IBPS PO 3rd Reserve List 2026?

Candidates can check the latest IBPS PO reserve-list provisional allotment by following these steps.

What Is the IBPS PO Reserve List?

The IBPS PO reserve list is maintained to consider eligible candidates for provisional allotment against vacancies remaining or subsequently by participating banks, in accordance with the applicable recruitment rules.

Candidates on the reserve list are not automatically guaranteed a bank allotment. Their selection depends on their merit position, category, preferences and the number of vacancies available during the relevant allotment round.

IBPS PO Third Reserve List 2026 - Provisional Allotment

The latest IBPS PO provisional allotment update concerns the CRP PO/MT-XV recruitment cycle. Candidates can check whether they have received an allotment through the official login portal.

The term provisional allotment means that a candidate has been allotted to a participating bank subject to eligibility verification and other applicable conditions. It does not automatically constitute a final appointment or joining order.

Details to Check in IBPS PO Reserve List Result 2026

After accessing the provisional allotment result, candidates should check the information displayed on the portal, which may include:

Candidates should retain a copy of the result and follow the instructions issued by IBPS and the allotted bank.

IBPS PO Reserve List 2026 Selection Criteria

Provisional allotment under the reserve list is governed by the recruitment rules applicable to CRP PO/MT-XV.

The following factors are relevant to reserve-list allotment:

  • Applicable merit position under the recruitment process
  • Candidate category and reservation requirements
  • Preferences submitted for participating banks
  • Vacancies by participating banks
  • Fulfilment of eligibility and allotment conditions

IBPS may issue further allotment updates according to the recruitment rules and availability of vacancies. Candidates should rely on official notices rather than assume that additional rounds are guaranteed.

What After IBPS PO 3rd Reserve List 2026?

Candidates who receive provisional allotment should carefully read their result and follow subsequent instructions from the allotted bank.

  1. Download or save the provisional allotment result.
  2. Check the allotted bank, if one is shown.
  3. Monitor official communication from the participating bank.
  4. Prepare the required identity, qualification and category certificates.
  5. Attend document verification or medical examination if instructed.
  6. Complete further recruitment formalities within the deadlines specified by the bank.

The allotment is subject to verification and does not guarantee appointment without completion of the prescribed requirements.

Documents Required After IBPS PO Reserve List Allotment

Candidates provisionally allotted to a participating bank should keep the relevant documents ready, subject to the bank's instructions.

  • Provisional allotment result or communication
  • Application and registration details
  • Valid government-issued photo identity proof
  • Date of birth proof
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Category, EWS or PwBD certificates, if applicable
  • Other documents requested by the allotted bank

The exact document requirements and verification schedule will be communicated by the relevant participating bank.

Candidates should note that the reserve list released in November 2026 belongs to the CRP PO/MT-XV recruitment cycle, whereas the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 being awaited for the current recruitment belongs to CRP PO/MT-XVI.

The examination follows section-wise time limits. Candidates must complete each section within its allotted duration.

SBI Clerk Mains Negative Marking 2026

There is negative marking in the SBI Clerk Main Examination. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer.

No penalty applies to questions left unanswered. Candidates should review the examination instructions and manage their time carefully during the test.

SBI Clerk Mains Exam Syllabus 2026

The SBI Clerk Mains Examination assesses candidates across four major subject areas.

General / Financial Awareness

This section covers current affairs, banking and financial awareness, economic developments and general knowledge.

General English

Questions assess reading comprehension, grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure and other English language skills.

Quantitative Aptitude

This section includes numerical ability, arithmetic, data interpretation and related quantitative problem-solving topics.

Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude

This section evaluates logical reasoning, analytical ability, puzzles, arrangements and computer aptitude.

Candidates should refer to the official examination information booklet for the applicable question pattern and instructions.

The SBI Clerk Mains Examination will be conducted at examination centres allotted by the bank. Candidates will receive their centre details through their individual Mains call letters.

  • Verify the allotted examination date, reporting time and venue.
  • Carry the printed call letter and prescribed identity documents.
  • Reach the examination centre before the reporting deadline.
  • Follow the biometric verification and examination procedures.
  • Do not carry prohibited electronic devices or restricted materials.
  • Follow the instructions provided by examination staff.

Main Examination Determining Merit for Selection
Local Language Proficiency Test Applicable to Candidates Not Exempt Under SBI Rules
Document and Eligibility Verification As Prescribed by SBI

Marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are not added to the final merit calculation. Selection is based on the applicable Mains examination performance and fulfilment of the recruitment requirements.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

JK Bank Recruitment 2026 includes 1,033 Banking Associate vacancies in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and 20 Probationary Officer vacancies in Ladakh. Jammu & Kashmir Bank Limited has issued separate detailed recruitment notifications for these posts. Online registration and fee payment are scheduled from 7 November to 26 November 2026 through the bank’s official Careers section.

Applicants must hold a recognised graduate degree and meet the applicable domicile and age conditions. Both posts have a base age range of 20–30 years as of 1 January 2026, with separate relaxation rules. Starting basic pay is ₹24,050 for Banking Associates and ₹48,480 for Probationary Officers. Candidates should read the notification for their intended post and Union Territory before applying.

JK Bank Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organisation Jammu & Kashmir Bank Limited
Post Names Banking Associate (J&K UT); Probationary Officer (Ladakh UT)
Total Vacancies 1,053 (only the two notifications covered here)
Qualification Graduation in any discipline or recognised equivalent
Age Limit 20–30 years as of 01 January 2026, before applicable relaxations
Application Start Date 07 November 2026
Last Date to Apply 26 November 2026
Mode of Application Online
Job Location / Domicile Banking Associate: J&K UT; PO: Ladakh UT
Selection Banking Associate: online examination; PO: prelims, mains and interview
Official Website https://jkb.bank.in/

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Registration Starts 07 November 2026
Last Date for Online Application 26 November 2026
Last Date for Online Fee Payment 26 November 2026
Exam Call Letters / Exam Dates To be notified separately by J&K Bank
PO Interview Date To be notified separately

JK Bank Vacancy Details

The two uploaded advertisements announce 1,053 vacancies: 1,033 for Banking Associates in J&K UT and 20 for Probationary Officers in Ladakh UT. Each recruitment follows its own reservation and domicile rules.

Post Union Territory Vacancies
Banking Associate Jammu & Kashmir 1,033
Probationary Officer Ladakh 20
Total 1,053

Reservation: The J&K Banking Associate notification references J&K UT reservation rules; the Ladakh PO notification references Ladakh UT reservation rules. Both show reservation percentages rather than a final category-wise vacancy allotment for each post. Category-wise vacancy counts have therefore not been inferred.

JK Bank Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for these posts must have completed graduation by the last date of registration. Domicile is post-specific: only J&K UT domiciles may apply for the Banking Associate notification, and only Ladakh UT domiciles may apply for the PO notification.

Post Educational Qualification Domicile
Banking Associate Graduate in any discipline from a university recognised by the Government of India, or equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government/UGC. Jammu & Kashmir UT
Probationary Officer Graduate in any discipline from a university recognised by the Government of India, or equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government/UGC. Ladakh UT

Candidates must possess valid graduation marksheets or degree certificates by 26 November 2026 and supply their graduation percentage when registering. Domicile certificates issued by the competent authority will be required as specified in the notifications. Candidates claiming reservation must have the relevant valid certificate when registering.

JK Bank Age Limit

The basic age requirement is calculated as of 01 January 2026. Both notifications prescribe a minimum age of 20 and maximum age of 30 before applicable relaxations.

Post Minimum Age Maximum Age (Basic)
Banking Associate – J&K 20 years 30 years
Probationary Officer – Ladakh 20 years 30 years

Age Relaxation

  • J&K Banking Associate: SC/ST candidates: 5 years; eligible Socially and Educationally Backward Class candidates: 3 years; PwBD candidates: 10 years. Ex-servicemen provisions are subject to the conditions in the notification. Eligible candidates who completed apprenticeship with J&K Bank receive an additional one-year relaxation.
  • Ladakh Probationary Officer: SC/ST and eligible SEBC (ALC) candidates: 5 years; PwBD candidates: 10 years. The notification also grants a one-time additional five-year age relaxation for 2025–2026 recruitment to both reserved and unreserved candidates, with total relaxations subject to an absolute maximum age of 56 years.

Important: Relaxations are governed by the relevant UT notification, including cumulative-relaxation rules. Do not apply J&K Banking Associate concessions to the Ladakh PO vacancy or vice versa.

JK Bank Application Fee

Application fees differ between the two notifications. All fees below exclude GST; online transaction charges are additional.

Post / UT Candidate Category Fee (excluding GST)
Banking Associate – J&K SC / ST / SEBC / PwBD / ESM ₹600
Banking Associate – J&K All other candidates ₹800
Probationary Officer – Ladakh SC / ST / SEBC / PwBD ₹1,000
Probationary Officer – Ladakh All other candidates ₹1,200

Payment is online through the application payment gateway. Candidates should retain the generated e-receipt and submitted application form.

JK Bank Selection Process

The selection processes are different for the two posts.

Post Selection Stages
Banking Associate – J&K IBPS-conducted online examination; subsequent eligibility and document verification. Provisional selection is based on the online examination score, subject to applicable rules.
Probationary Officer – Ladakh Preliminary examination → Main examination → Interview, followed by eligibility and document verification. Final Mains/Interview score weighting: 80:20.

For Banking Associates, minimum aggregate qualifying marks are stated as 40% for General and 35% for reserved-category candidates, subject to overall merit. For PO recruitment, shortlisted candidates advance through the notified examination and interview stages.

JK Bank Exam Pattern 2026

Banking Associate Online Exam and PO Preliminary Exam

The uploaded notifications prescribe the following subject-wise pattern for the Banking Associate online examination and PO preliminary examination.

Test Questions Marks Duration
English Language 30 30 20 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 35 30 20 minutes
Reasoning Ability 35 40 20 minutes
Total 100 100 60 minutes

Negative marking: One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for an incorrect answer. No penalty applies to unanswered questions.

Probationary Officer Main Examination

Test Questions Marks Duration
Reasoning 40 60 45 minutes
General/Economy/Banking/Digital/Financial Awareness, including RBI Circulars 50 60 35 minutes
English Language 40 20 35 minutes
Data Analysis & Interpretation 40 60 45 minutes
Objective Total 170 200 160 minutes
Descriptive Paper (Essay & Comprehension) 2 25 30 minutes

JK Bank Salary Details

The figures below are starting basic pay, not monthly in-hand salary. Other applicable perks are governed by the respective cadre rules.

Post Starting Basic Pay Pay Scale
Banking Associate ₹24,050 ₹24,050–1,340/3–28,070–1,650/3–33,020–2,000/4–41,020–2,340/7–57,400–4,400/1–61,800–2,680–64,480
Probationary Officer ₹48,480 ₹48,480–2,000/7–62,480–2,340/2–67,160–2,680/7–85,920

Posting conditions: Selected Banking Associates must serve at least five years within their initially allotted J&K zone; Ladakh Probationary Officers must serve at least five years within the Ladakh zone. The Banking Associate probation period is initially six months, while the PO probation period is two years.

How to Apply for JK Bank Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can register online through the Careers section of the bank’s official website by 26 November 2026.

  1. Visit jkb.bank.in and open the Careers section.
  2. Select the correct detailed notification for J&K Banking Associate or Ladakh Probationary Officer.
  3. Choose Apply Online, complete new registration and note the registration number and password.
  4. Enter personal, educational, domicile and reservation-category information accurately.
  5. Upload the required photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration and supporting documents as directed in the application portal.
  6. Preview and verify all details before completing registration.
  7. Pay the applicable online fee, submit the form and save the application and payment receipt.

Incorrect category or personal details may affect eligibility. Applicants should consult the post-specific PDF for complete upload sizes, document formats and declarations.

How to Download IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026?

Candidates can download the IBPS RRB PO prelims call letter using their registration details through the official IBPS recruitment portal.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at www.ibps.in.
  2. Click the CRP RRBs recruitment section.
  3. Select Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks XV.
  4. Find the Online Preliminary Exam Call Letter for Officer Scale-I link.
  5. Open the official admit-card login page.
  6. Enter your Registration Number or Roll Number.
  7. Enter your password or date of birth in the prescribed format.
  8. Complete the security verification displayed on the screen.
  9. Click Login to access your call letter.
  10. Check the examination date, shift, centre and personal details.
  11. Download the admit card.
  12. Print a clear copy and retain it for examination use.

  2. Enter the correct registration or roll number.
  3. Check the password or date-of-birth format.
  4. Complete any security verification carefully.
  5. Retry after a short interval if the website is slow.
  6. Check registration confirmation messages for the correct credentials.
  7. Use the official IBPS grievance or assistance facility if the issue continues.

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has invited online applications for the post of Part-time Counsellor on contract basis at its office in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai, for a fixed remuneration of ₹75,000 per month. Applicants need a post graduate degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognised University/Institution and at least two years' post qualification experience in Clinical Psychology. The online application link is open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026, and selection is by interview.

SEBI Part-time Counsellor at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationSecurities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
Post NamePart-time Counsellor (on Contract Basis)
PayFixed remuneration of ₹75,000/- per month
Job LocationSEBI office, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai
Application ModeOnline only
Last Date to Apply15 December 2026

The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

About SEBI

SEBI is a statutory body established by an Act of Parliament. According to the notice, it exists to protect the interests of investors in securities, to promote the development of the securities market and to regulate it.

Who Can Apply

RequirementDetails
Educational qualificationPost graduate degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognised University/Institution
ExperienceMinimum of two years' post qualification experience in the field of Clinical Psychology

The notice invites applications from professionals with this qualification and experience. The Board reserves the right to raise the minimum standards for qualifications and experience in order to restrict the number of candidates called for the interview. Meeting the stated conditions therefore does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

Pay and Tenure

The Part-time Counsellor is engaged on contract basis at a fixed remuneration of ₹75,000/- per month. The notice states the following terms:

  • No superannuation benefits, namely pension, Provident Fund or gratuity, will be payable.
  • No leave would be admissible.
  • No perquisites or facilities would be made available.
  • Taxes on the income would be deducted at source as per extant rates and Government notifications.

The length of the contract is not specified in the notice.

SEBI Part-time Counsellor Job Description

  • Provide counselling services for employees of SEBI.
  • Work at the SEBI office in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai.
  • Work three days a week, 8 hours per day and 96 hours per month.

How to Apply for SEBI Part-time Counsellor

  1. Open the online application form through the link in the notice (https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/other/OtherAction.do?doCounsellorForm=yes). The link is also provided on the SEBI website under the Careers Section.
  2. Fill the online application form. The notice says candidates shall mandatorily apply this way.
  3. Submit the application between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026, while the online link remains open.

Applications which are not submitted online shall not be considered. The notice does not list any documents to attach.

Selection and Interview

The mode of selection is Interview. The Board reserves the right to modify the selection procedure if it deems fit. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

Organisation The Andhra Pradesh State Co-operative Bank Ltd., Head Office, Governorpet, Vijayawada
Post Name(s) Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO)

The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the pay amount.

About APCOB

The Andhra Pradesh State Co-operative Bank Ltd. describes itself as a State Partnered Scheduled Bank. Its Head Office is at N.T.R Sahakara Bhavan, Governorpeta, Vijayawada, and the notice is issued by its HRMD department. This is a contract post for APCOB and the DCCBs, not a regular appointment.

Who Can Apply

The notice gives one set of conditions for the post of Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO). Age is counted as on 01.09.2026. Minimum 40 years and maximum 62 years. No age relaxation is printed in the notice.

Post Essential Qualification Desirable
Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) Graduate from recognised University/Institution MBA/PGDM in Management/Marketing/Finance/Banking, CAIIB or other relevant professional qualification

Mandatory experience

  • Minimum 15 years of experience in banking/financial services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership/business management role involving responsibility for a region/zone/business vertical/large portfolio or multi-branch network.
  • The candidate should be serving, or should have served, at Scale-V or above in a Scheduled Commercial Bank/Regional Rural Bank/Cooperative Bank, or in an equivalent senior management position in a reputed private sector bank/financial institution.

Desirable experience

  • Preference goes to candidates with demonstrated and quantifiable achievements in business growth, deposits/CASA mobilisation, retail/agri/MSME lending, branch productivity, customer acquisition, product development or business turnaround.
  • Experience or exposure in Rural Banking, Agriculture Finance, MSME, Financial Inclusion, SHG/JLG/FPO financing, Government business or rural distribution networks is an added advantage.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

Pay and Tenure

The selected candidate will be paid a consolidated monthly remuneration, market-linked and commensurate with qualification, experience, current/last drawn compensation and suitability, within the limits approved under the Bank's Contractual Appointment Policy. The notice prints no amount. The CBDO oversees the functioning of the Bank's Business Development of APCOB and DCCBs for a contractual term of one year initially, extendable annually based on performance and requirement of the Bank.

Leave terms: Paid Leave of 1 day for each completed month, maximum 12 days over 12 months, without carry forward. Leave may be availed not exceeding 4 days at a stretch. Any other absence is Loss of Pay affecting the Fixed Component of the compensation package. Accumulated leave is not eligible for encashment.

Place of posting: The Andhra Pradesh State Co-operative Bank ltd., Head Office, Governorpet, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh.

APCOB Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) Job Description

The notice lists the roles and responsibilities under ten heads:

  • Business Strategy, Planning and Growth: formulate business development strategies and plans for APCOB and DCCBs, drive growth in deposits, advances and fee-based income, monitor performance against targets, build models using the DCCB–PACS network as a last-mile channel, and develop annual/quarterly business KRAs.
  • Deposit, CASA, Credit and Institutional Business Development: strengthen low-cost deposits and CASA, find branches below potential, identify Government Departments, Corporations, educational institutions, temples and local bodies for deposit business, and expand asset business.
  • Product Development, Digital Business and Customer Proposition: facilitate deposit, loan and other products, develop distinctive customer value propositions ("WOW" factors), and promote digital banking and alternate delivery channels.
  • Customer Segmentation and Rural Market Development: segment customers by occupation, livelihood, cropping patterns, income and banking behaviour, and target farmers, agricultural labourers, tenant farmers, SHGs, JLGs, FPOs, rural artisans, rural youth and pensioners.
  • DCCB and Branch Business Transformation: assess DCCB potential, study branches with low business/viability, and replicate successful practices across branches and DCCBs.
  • Marketing, Customer Acquisition and Business Partnerships: marketing and branding strategies, customer acquisition and retention, and institutional tie-ups and partnerships.
  • Market Intelligence, Benchmarking and Business Analytics: benchmark against leading commercial banks and analyse business data and market trends for Management.
  • Field Engagement, Capacity Building and Implementation Support: field visits to APCOB branches, DCCBs and DCCB branches across the State, workshops and training, and mentoring of branches.
  • Profitable Growth, Risk Alignment and Performance Governance: keep growth aligned with asset quality, regulatory requirements, approved policies and risk appetite, and submit periodic reports to Senior Management.
  • Other Responsibilities: other business development functions assigned by the Senior Management/Board of Management from time to time.

How to Apply for APCOB Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO)

  1. Take the prescribed proforma application from the Bank's website, www.apcob.bank.in. Applications are accepted from 09.11.2026 to 19.11.2026.
  2. Submit the application in the prescribed format through post/email with self-attested supporting documents of age proof, educational qualification, experience and other credentials.
  3. Pay the fee of Rs.1000/- by Demand Draft favouring "THE ANDHRA PRADESH STATE COOPERATIVE BANK LTD" payable at Vijayawada, or through NEFT/IMPS/UPI to A/c No: 610000006843, A/c Name: APCOB-HRMD, IFSC: APBL0000002.
  4. Address the application to: General Manager (HRMD), The A.P. State Cooperative Bank Ltd, NTR Sahakara Bhavan, D No. 27-29-28, Governorpet, Vijaayawada-520002.
  5. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CBDO, APCOB & DCCBs." on top of the envelope.

The notice does not name a separate email address for applications. The letterhead prints the HRMD department's mail as [email protected] and its phone as 0866-2429011.

Candidates working in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Commercial banks should apply through proper channel. If an employer recommendation is delayed, they may send an advance copy with all requirements except the recommendation before 19.11.2026. The application duly recommended by the employer must reach the Bank by 25.11.2026.

Selection and Interview

Selection is through interview and personal interaction, on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the interview/interaction. Meeting the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to an interview. APCOB reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates after preliminary screening/shortlisting with reference to qualification, experience and profile against job requirements.

Candidates shortlisted for interview must share a 3-year Business Transformation Strategy for APCOB and DCCBs, covering deposits/CASA, agriculture/MSME/retail advances, PACS-led business acquisition, digital channels, product innovation, branch productivity and profitability. This is to be shared before the interviews, as per communication from the Bank during the selection process. The notice gives no interview date. All further announcements will be provided only on www.apcob.bank.in from time to time.

  • The decision of APCOB on eligibility and selection is final and binding, and no representation or correspondence will be entertained.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Notification: State Bank of India (SBI) has released Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/28 for 60 Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) vacancies under Specialist Cadre Officer recruitment on a regular basis. Candidates must be graduates with the prescribed experience as officers in the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force or paramilitary forces. The age limit is 25 to 40 years as on 31 October 2026, with applicable relaxation. The starting basic pay is Rs. 85,920 for Manager and Rs. 64,820 for Deputy Manager. Online applications are open from 4 November to 25 November 2026 through the official SBI Careers website at sbi.bank.in.

Important: This recruitment is intended for candidates with qualifying military or paramilitary officer experience. Graduation without the prescribed service experience does not meet the eligibility requirements. Applicants must also possess medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent category.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must have completed graduation from a Government-recognized university or institution and possess the specified experience as commissioned officers in the Armed Forces or officers in paramilitary forces.

SBI SO Educational Qualification

Post Name Qualification
Manager (Security) Graduate in Any Discipline from a Government-Recognized University or Institution

The educational qualification alone does not establish eligibility. Candidates must also meet the respective service rank, experience and medical fitness requirements as on 31 October 2026.

SBI Manager (Security) Experience Requirements

Candidates applying for Manager (Security) in MMGS-III must satisfy either of the following conditions:

  • An officer not below the rank of Major in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 10 years of commissioned service.
  • An officer not below the rank of Deputy Commandant in paramilitary forces, with at least 10 years of service as an officer in the force.

SBI Deputy Manager (Security) Experience Requirements

Candidates applying for Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-II must satisfy either of the following conditions:

  • An officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 5 years of commissioned service.
  • An officer not below the rank of Assistant Commandant in paramilitary forces, with at least 5 years of service as an officer in the force.

SBI SO Medical Fitness Requirement

Only candidates possessing medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent medical category as on the release date of the advertisement are eligible.

Retired candidates must upload the relevant medical category information from their discharge book or service record. Candidates currently serving must upload their latest Medical Board document indicating their medical category.

Selected officers will also be eligible for applicable Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), Provident Fund, National Pension System (NPS), Leave Fare Concession, medical facilities and other benefits under SBI rules.

Salary Clarification: These amounts represent basic pay scales, not guaranteed monthly in-hand salaries. Actual earnings depend on allowances, posting and applicable deductions.

SBI SO Probation Period

The probation period for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) is six months, as specified in the recruitment notification.

SBI SO Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview. The final merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Professional Knowledge and 30% to the interview.

  1. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the objective examination.
  2. Shortlisting: SBI shortlists candidates based on the examination results and applicable requirements.
  3. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates attend an interview carrying 100 marks.
  4. Document Verification: Educational qualifications, service experience, medical fitness and category certificates are verified.
  5. Final Merit List: Prepared using normalized Professional Knowledge and interview marks.

SBI reserves the right to modify the selection process, including considering shortlisting followed by interview, if required.

SBI SO Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination contains 200 objective questions carrying 200 marks, with a total duration of two hours.

Subject Questions Marks Duration

English Language 50 50 30 Minutes
General Awareness 50 25 25 Minutes
Professional Knowledge 50 100 35 Minutes
Total 200 200 120 Minutes

Important SBI SO Exam Rules

  • Reasoning Ability, English Language and General Awareness are qualifying in nature.
  • Marks obtained in these three qualifying sections are not counted toward final merit.
  • Candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks fixed by SBI in the applicable sections.
  • Professional Knowledge carries 100 marks and contributes to final merit.
  • There is no negative marking for incorrect answers.

SBI SO Final Merit Calculation

Selection Component Maximum Marks Normalized Weightage

Personal Interview 100 30 Marks
Total 200 100 Marks

If candidates have the same score at the cut-off point, SBI will rank them according to age in descending order.

Candidates should refer to Annexure I of the official notification for the complete topic-wise syllabus rather than relying only on this summary.

SBI Security Officer Job Responsibilities

Selected Manager and Deputy Manager (Security) officers will be responsible for improving security arrangements at SBI branches and offices.

  • Conduct periodic security audits of branches and offices.
  • Review existing security arrangements and recommend improvements.
  • Organize security drills, lectures and employee awareness programmes.
  • Monitor security systems and reduce incidents caused by security lapses.
  • Support implementation of disaster management plans.
  • Visit branches and other administrative units to assess security requirements.
  • Coordinate with civil, military, police and other Government authorities.
  • Perform additional security administration duties assigned by SBI.

Selected officers may be posted or transferred to SBI offices anywhere in India according to the Bank's requirements.

Senior Relationship Manager Work Experience Requirement

Candidates must have at least three years of post-qualification experience as a Relationship Manager in Wealth Management, Investment Advisory or Portfolio Management.

The experience may be with eligible organizations such as:

  • Public Sector Banks.
  • Private Sector Banks.
  • Foreign Banks.
  • Broking Firms.
  • Securities Firms.
  • Asset Management Companies.
  • Other relevant Financial Services organizations.

Important: Experience in a clerical cadre, teaching or training is not counted for determining the prescribed eligibility. The Bank also excludes post-qualification employment periods of less than six months in an organization when calculating experience.

Preferred Qualification for Senior Relationship Manager

The notification lists the following preferred qualifications:

  • Two-year full-time postgraduate degree or diploma in Management.
  • MBA in Finance, Marketing or Banking.
  • Certified Financial Planner (CFP).
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or equivalent qualification.
  • NISM XIII and NISM Series XXI-A certifications.

Qualification Clarification: An MBA is preferred, not mandatory, for the Senior Relationship Manager position. However, graduation alone is insufficient because the prescribed professional certification and work experience are mandatory.

Senior Relationship Manager Job Responsibilities

Selected candidates will manage customer relationships, support wealth management business growth and provide appropriate investment solutions to clients.

  • Acquire and manage affluent, High Net Worth Individual (HNI) and other wealth management customers.
  • Build and maintain long-term client relationships.
  • Increase Assets Under Management (AUM) and investment product business.
  • Understand customer financial goals and investment requirements.
  • Promote suitable mutual fund, insurance, portfolio management and other investment products.
  • Conduct customer portfolio reviews and financial planning discussions.
  • Support business development and customer retention.
  • Maintain customer service, documentation and regulatory compliance standards.

  5. Document Verification: Original certificates and experience documents will be checked.
  6. Final Selection: Candidates will be selected according to the applicable assessment results, eligibility and vacancies.

One post of EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk (UR), in the grade of Executive Vice President, is open at the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) on a fixed-term (contract) basis. Indian citizens can send their CV with a passport sized photograph by email to [email protected] from 3 November 2026. Applications must be received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.
