The official notification does not specify the application fee.

About NaBFID

The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

Where and How to Send

NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent.

  1. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description.
  2. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph.
  3. Send the CV by email to [email protected].
  4. Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16.
  5. Make sure the email is received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.

Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The advertisement covers a single post in the grade of Executive Vice President: Sl. No. 01, EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk, Job Code NABFID/EVP/16, 1 vacancy (UR).

Educational Qualification

  • Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account.
  • Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute.

Experience

  • Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector.
  • Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity).
  • Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level.
  • Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred.

Age Limit

The age limit is 55 years and below, as on the date of advertisement. After applying all relaxations in terms of age, the maximum age of candidates shall not exceed 55 years. Candidates should satisfy themselves about their eligibility as on the cut-off date, 3 November 2026.

Nationality

The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens.

Pay and Terms of Engagement

  • Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice.
  • Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank.
  • Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement.
  • Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.

Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

NaBFID Recruitment 2026 Job Description

  • Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework.
  • Ensuring that the Bank's portfolio is built within the defined risk parameters.
  • Building appropriate mechanisms to measure risk.
  • Providing advice and structuring risk mitigation into the business operations at NaBFID.

A detailed role description is available as a separate document on the NaBFID website, linked from the notice.

Enclosures

  • CV including a passport sized photograph (with the email application).
  • No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview, for candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings including Nationalised Banks and Financial Institutions.
  • Details of criminal case(s) pending, if any, at the time of interview.
  • Proper relieving letters from the employer at the time of taking up the appointment, in case of selection.

Selection Process

Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience, and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

  • Screening and shortlisting: based on eligibility and relevant experience. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • Additional assessment: shortlisted candidates may undergo psychometric tests and/or assessment centre and/or any other selection method deemed suitable by NaBFID, in addition to the personal interview.
  • Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose.
  • Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee, and its decision will be final.

The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.

  • Candidates appearing for the interview process will be reimbursed for economy class airfare expenses.
  • Government, quasi-government, PSU, nationalised bank and financial institution employees who fail to submit the NOC at interview may not be considered, and travelling expenses otherwise admissible will not be paid.
  • Intimations will be sent by email only to the email ID and mobile number provided; the Bank is not responsible if they do not reach candidates due to a change in contact details, technical fault or otherwise.
  • The Bank may conduct independent verification, including police records, and reserves the right to deny the engagement depending on such disclosures or verification.
  • If a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms or has furnished false information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will be cancelled; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be terminated without notice.
  • NaBFID reserves the right to amend, rescind or re-advertise the position at any time without assigning any reasons.
  • Decisions of the Bank on eligibility, interviews, other tests and selection are final; no representation or correspondence will be entertained.
  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai, and courts, tribunals and forums at Mumbai have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • All changes, updates and corrigenda will be hosted only on the careers page of the Bank's website (nabfid.org/careers); no separate intimation will be issued.

State Bank of India (SBI) has announced 3 vacancies for the Risk Specialist post under its 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible candidates possessing a CA, CFA, MBA, PGDM or equivalent degree in Finance, Data Analytics or Business Analytics can submit their ONLINE application. The notified pay scale is 64820-2340/1-67160-2680/10-93960, and online registration along with fee payment can be done from 02.11.2026 to 23.11.2026. The selection process comprises shortlisting and an interview, with selected candidates placed on probation as per existing Bank's recruitment Policy in-force / amended/ modified from time to time under advertisement number CRPD/SCO/2026-27/27.

SBI Risk Specialist at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation State Bank of India (SBI)

About SBI Risk Specialist Recruitment

The Central Recruitment & Promotion Department of the State Bank of India, located at the Corporate Centre in Mumbai, conducts regular recruitment for specialist cadre officers. This recruitment cycle invites applications for the Risk Specialist position under Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) to handle expected credit loss modelling, macroeconomic overlays, and model risk management.

Vacancy Details

The recruitment offers a total of 3 regular vacancies for the Risk Specialist post under the Unreserved (UR) category (with PwBD-VI horizontal reservation of 1 vacancy). The post-wise and category-wise break-up is detailed below.

Name of Post Type of Vacancy Grade SC ST OBC EWS UR Total
Risk Specialist Regular MMGS-II - - - - 3 3

Who Can Apply

Candidates must fulfill the mandatory educational qualification, age limits, and post-qualification experience requirements as on 31.10.2026.

  • Age Limit: Minimum 25 years and Maximum 35 years as on 31.10.2026. Upper age limit is for unreserved category candidates. Relaxation in upper age limit is available to reserved category candidates as per Govt. of India guidelines (wherever applicable).
  • Essential Qualification: Mandatory: (i) CA or (ii) CFA or (iii) MBA / PGDM or equivalent degree in Finance / Data Analytics / Business Analytics from a recognized institute.
  • Preferred Qualification / Certification: Financial Risk Manager (FRM) by GARP OR Professional Risk Managers by PRMIA (valid as on 31.10.2026).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in dealing with Expected Credit Loss (ECL) related modelling in Risk Management Department of any Bank / Financial Institution / Rating Agency / Brokerage firm or Risk Advisory in Consulting Firm as on 31.10.2026. Training & teaching experience will not be counted for eligibility.

Pay and Tenure

Selected candidates are appointed in Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) on a regular basis with a basic pay scale of 64820-2340/1-67160-2680/10-93960. The official will be eligible for DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, Contributory Pension Fund i.e. NPS, Leave Fare Concession (LFC), Medical Facility, other perquisites etc. as per Bank’s salary structure.

SBI Risk Specialist Job Description

Selected candidates will be assigned roles and Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) that include:

  • Development of Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD) and Exposure at Default (EAD) models for various loan portfolio and investments on which ECL is applicable.
  • Development of Macroeconomic Overlays models required as per regulatory guidelines.
  • Implementation of PD, LGD and EAD Models in OFSAA.
  • Period Monitoring, Maintenance and validation of above models.
  • Preparation of Framework for Determination of Stage under ECL.
  • Identification of Significant Increase in Credit Risk (SICR) triggers along with setting qualitative and quantitative triggers for various portfolio.
  • Coordinate with Auditors & Regulator, BUs & other stakeholders throughout model lifecycle.
  • Maintain proper Model documents and database required for audit & regulatory supervision.
  • Develop models required for ECL computation using industry best practices and using statistical and machine learning techniques.

How to Apply for SBI Risk Specialist

  1. Visit the official SBI careers portal at https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
  2. Navigate to the advertisement for CRPD/SCO/2026-27/27 and click on the registration link.
  3. Register online by providing basic details. Note down the system-generated provisional registration number and password.
  4. Scan and upload your recent passport-size photograph (20 kb - 50 kb, dimensions 200 x 230 pixels) and signature (10 kb - 20 kb, dimensions 140 x 60 pixels) as per the specified dimensions and formats.
  5. Upload required documents in PDF format (not exceeding 500 kb each), including Biodata, Brief Resume, ID Proof, Proof of Date of Birth, Educational Certificates (Relevant Mark-Sheets/ Degree Certificate), Preferred qualification / Certification (if any), Experience certificates, Caste Certificate / EWS Certificate (if applicable), PwBD Certificate (if applicable), and Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary slip from current employer.
  6. Verify all filled details carefully before final submission, as no modifications are allowed after final submission.
  7. Pay the application fee online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card.
  8. Save and print the e-receipt and system-generated online application form for future reference.

Selection and Interview

The selection process consists of two stages:

  • Shortlisting: Mere fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience will not vest any right to candidate for being called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and thereafter, adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank, will be shortlisted for interaction.
  • Interview: Interview will carry 100 marks. The qualifying marks in interview will be decided by the Bank. Merit list for selection will be prepared in descending order on the basis of scores obtained in interview only.

The recruitment is conducted by the Central Recruitment & Promotion Department of State Bank of India at its Corporate Centre, Mumbai. Both posts are in the bank's Specialist Cadre and will have no provision for conversion into the General cadre. The work centres on research and development of derivative and other market products for the bank's corporate and retail clients.

The notice lists 7 vacancies: 1 for Chief Manager and 6 for Manager. The PwBD vacancy is horizontal and is covered under the parent category. The bank states that the number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to its actual requirement.

The posts are open to eligible Indian citizens. Qualification and experience are counted as on 30.09.2026. Each post also requires proficiency in spoken and written English.

SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description

Chief Manager (Product & Research - Forex & Rupee Derivatives)

The selected candidate will support the development and delivery of customized solutions to clients. The candidate must also ensure that product offerings stay aligned with evolving market dynamics and regulatory expectations. The job profile includes:

  • Conducting research followed by development of new derivative products in line with the prevailing market.
  • Evaluating the performance of the product on an ongoing basis.
  • Assisting marketing of derivative products to the clients.
  • Providing periodic updates to the Top Management.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs):

  • Lead product conceptualization and development of new derivative instruments.
  • Conduct advanced macroeconomic and interest rate research to support product suitability.
  • Prepare product notes, risk disclosures and documentation for approval committees.
  • Evaluate product performance and recommend product positioning strategies.
  • Coordinate with internal departments such as risk, legal, IAD and ITTSS for timely approvals and clearances within the regulatory and internal compliance framework.
  • Coordinate closely with CTMU/RTMUs to drive derivative penetration across the bank's corporate and retail clients.
  • Handle the end-to-end process of product development and approval.
  • Assist in automation and integration of compliance workflows.
  • Mentor AVP-level team members and contribute to strategic product planning.
  • Any other related work as assigned.

Manager (Product & Research Analyst)

  • Design tailored products based on the client's need and market dynamics, and keep up with developments in derivative products and regulatory frameworks.
  • Conduct Fundamental and Technical research across Equities, Forex and Debt Markets.
  • Analyse macroeconomic trends, central bank policies and geopolitical developments, and assess their market impact.
  • Generate and maintain financial models and prepare valuation reports.
  • Monitor the markets and assess the client's requirements.
  • Provide necessary support in product development.
  • Liaise with various departments involved in designing and developing new products.
  • Provide regular updates to the stakeholders and Top Management.
  • Track and analyse corporate earnings, bond yield movements and currency fluctuations.
  • Prepare and present research notes, market outlook and sectoral reports.
  • Collaborate with the trading desk to align strategies with research insights.

For the Manager post, the KRAs may be finalized after selection. The notice states that the job profiles and KRAs for both posts are illustrative, and the bank may assign other roles from time to time.

How to Apply for SBI Recruitment 2026

Applications are accepted only online through the link on the bank's website. No other mode of application will be entertained, and the hard copy of the application and documents must not be sent. Registration is complete only when the fee is paid online on or before the last date.

  1. Log in to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings, scroll down and click on advertisement no. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/26, then download the advertisement.
  2. Click Apply Online and register using a valid email ID and mobile number. Keep both active until the result is declared.
  3. Upload a scanned photograph and signature. The application will not be registered without them.
  4. Fill in the application. Saving it generates a provisional registration number and password, and the saved information can be edited three times only.
  5. Upload each document through its separate Upload link, and check it with Preview. Documents cannot be changed after upload or submission.
  6. Submit the application and pay the fee through the integrated payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking etc.). No edits are allowed after payment, and transaction charges are borne by the candidate.
  7. Print and keep the e-receipt and the application form generated after successful payment. The notice says they can be reprinted later.

  • Mandatory educational certificates: degree certificate (PDF)
  • Experience certificates, mandatory (PDF)

  • Biodata Form, duly filled, signed and scanned in PDF. The form is available on the bank's career website under the advertisement.
  • Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary slip from the current employer (PDF)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if available, at registration; otherwise it must be produced at the interview. The NOC is mandatory for those working in a Government Institute, Public Sector Unit or Public Sector Bank.

File specifications

  • Photograph: recent passport-style colour picture against a light, preferably white, background. File size 20 kb - 50 kb, dimensions 200 x 230 pixels (preferred). Caps, hats and dark glasses are not acceptable. Religious headwear is allowed if it does not cover the face.
  • Signature: signed by the applicant on white paper with a black ink pen. File size 10 kb - 20 kb, dimensions 140 x 60 pixels (preferred). A signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Documents: PDF on A4 page size, each not exceeding 500 kb, clear and readable.
  • Scanning: resolution of at least 200 dpi, True Color, and photo/signature files in JPG or JPEG format.

The fee and intimation charges are non-refundable. A paid fee cannot be refunded on any account or adjusted for any other examination or selection. Candidates seeking fee exemption must submit a valid certificate from the Competent Authority when it is sought at document verification; otherwise their candidature is liable to be cancelled.

Selection and Interview

Selection for both posts is on the basis of shortlisting and interview.

  • Shortlisting: Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give a right to an interview. A shortlisting committee of the bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and call an adequate number of candidates.
  • Interview: The interview carries 100 marks. The bank will decide the qualifying marks. The bank will also decide the interview venue or centre, and no request for a change will be entertained.
  • Merit list: The merit list will be prepared in descending order of interview scores only. Candidates with the same marks at the cut-off point will be ranked according to their age in descending order.
  • Call letter: The interview intimation will be sent by email or uploaded on the bank's website. No hard copy will be sent.

Shortlisting is provisional and done without verifying documents. All details and documents will be verified against the originals when a candidate reports for interview. A candidate found ineligible at the interview will not be allowed to appear and will not get travel expenses.

  • No change in category or other particulars is allowed after submission. Updates, corrigenda and results will be hosted only on the bank's website, and queries can be sent through https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/post-your-query.

RRB Group D Cut Off 2026

The RRBs have released the cut off marks along with the result, separately for each zone and category. Cut off is based on normalised CBT marks, because the CBT was held over many days and shifts. Normalisation is applied whenever a CBT is conducted in multiple sessions for the same syllabus.

Minimum Qualifying Marks in the CBT

Every candidate must first meet the minimum qualifying percentage for their category. Meeting this percentage alone does not guarantee shortlisting, because shortlisting for the PET depends on merit within each RRB and category.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Shortlisting in the CBT result is provisional. Eligibility is verified against original documents only at Document Verification, and a wrong claim leads to cancellation of candidature.
  • Qualifying in the PET and later stages does not give a right to appointment. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.
  • Check the result and download call letters only from the official RRB and RRC websites. Beware of fake websites and job racketeers.
  • Dates and venues of PET, Document Verification and Medical Examination will be shared through the official websites, SMS and email. Requests to change a date, shift or venue are not entertained.
  • Keep your registered mobile number and email ID active, because all communication is sent there.

Candidates can check the KPSC KAS provisional answer keys through the official Commission website. Follow the steps below to access the Paper 1 and Paper 2 key answers.

  1. Visit the official Karnataka Public Service Commission website at kpsc.karnataka.gov.in.
  2. Open the Answer Keys section of the website.
  3. Find the provisional key answers for the 2026-27 Gazetted Probationers Preliminary Examination held on 15 November 2026.

KPSC KAS Answer Key 2026 Objection Process

KPSC has provided an online facility for candidates to raise objections against the provisional answer keys. Candidates who find a discrepancy in the published answers can submit their objections through the official portal until 19 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

Objections must be submitted through the prescribed online link. Objections sent through other modes will not be considered, according to the supplied notice details.

How to Raise Objections Against KPSC KAS Answer Key 2026?

  1. Visit the official objection portal at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kpscobjection/forms/login.aspx.
  2. Enter the required candidate details, including the application or registration number, name, date of birth and captcha.
  3. Select the applicable examination and proceed through the objection facility.
  4. Enter the relevant examination details, question paper version and question number for the answer being challenged.
  5. Upload the supporting documents in PDF format, ensuring the file does not exceed 1 MB.
  6. Pay the prescribed objection fee of Rs. 50 for each objection.
  7. Complete the online submission before 19 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

Candidates should carefully verify the question details and supporting documents before submitting their objections. Incomplete objections, objections without supporting evidence or submissions without the prescribed fee will not be considered.

Is the KPSC KAS Prelims Answer Key 2026 released?

Where can I download the KPSC KAS Answer Key 2026?

The last date to submit objections against the KPSC KAS provisional answer keys is 19 November 2026. The online objection facility closes at 10:30 AM.

KPSC has prescribed a fee of Rs. 50 for each objection submitted against the provisional answer keys. Candidates must complete the required payment through the official objection portal.

How to Download SBI Clerk Backlog Prelims Answer Key 2026?

Candidates can access the SBI Clerk Backlog Phase-I marks facility by following these steps.

SBI Clerk Backlog Prelims Response Sheet 2026

Recruitment websites have that the SBI Clerk Backlog Prelims Response Sheet 2026 is available along with the answer key. A response sheet generally allows candidates to review their marked responses and compare them with the answers used for evaluation.

However, the publicly accessible SBI page confirms the facility for checking marks secured in Phase-I. It does not separately identify the question-wise response-sheet download facility before candidate login.

Candidates should check the options available after logging in and follow any additional instructions issued by SBI.

SBI Clerk Backlog Prelims Marks 2026

The State Bank of India has made the Preliminary Examination marks facility available for candidates who appeared under the SC/ST/OBC backlog recruitment drive.

The Phase-I marks statement allows candidates to check their Preliminary Examination performance. Candidates should download or save their marks for future reference.

The Preliminary Examination is qualifying in nature, and its marks are not added to the final merit calculation for Junior Associate recruitment.

SBI Clerk Backlog Prelims Exam Pattern 2026

The SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination consists of three sections with a total of 100 questions carrying 100 marks. The examination duration is one hour.

Subject Questions Maximum Marks
English Language 30 30
Numerical Ability 35 35
Reasoning Ability 35 35
Total 100 100

The examination includes negative marking of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

How to Calculate Marks Using SBI Clerk Prelims Answer Key 2026?

If candidates can access their question-wise responses and correct answers, they may estimate their raw scores using the prescribed marking scheme.

Response Type Marks
Correct Answer +1
Incorrect Answer -0.25
Unattempted Question 0

Estimated Raw Score = (Correct Answers × 1) - (Incorrect Answers × 0.25)

For example, if a candidate has 72 correct answers and 13 incorrect answers, the estimated raw score would be 68.75 marks.

This calculation is only an estimate. Candidates should rely on the marks displayed by SBI as their official examination score.

SBI Clerk Backlog Answer Key 2026 Objection Process

The reviewed official SBI Phase-I marks page does not publish a separate answer key objection link, objection fee or submission deadline.

Candidates should check the official SBI Careers portal for any examination-specific instructions. They should not assume that an objection window is available without a corresponding announcement from the bank.

JKSSB Accounts Assistant Answer Key 2026 Objection Process

Candidates can object to any answer in the Accounts Assistant provisional key. They must use the Annexure "B" format and send hard copies, with documentary proof, to a JKSSB office.

  • The form asks for your name, exam name, advertisement number, application number, roll number, date of exam, exam centre division (Jammu/Kashmir), correspondence address, mobile number, demand draft number and date, your 16-digit account number and IFSC code, the question number and series, details of the objection, and the correct answer or option in your view.

  • If an objection is found correct, the answer key will be revised for all candidates. Candidates will not be told individually whether their objection was accepted or rejected.

Provisional Answer Key vs Revised Answer Key

Many candidates search for the difference between the two keys before checking their marks. The table explains it in a simple way.

Point Provisional Answer Key Revised Answer Key (Master Set)

Purpose Lets candidates check answers and raise objections Gives the updated correct answers used for evaluation

How to Download the UPSSSC Revised Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website of UPSSSC at upsssc.gov.in.
  2. Open the News section on the homepage.
  3. Find the notice for your advertisement number: 06-Exam/2026 (Technical Assistant Group-C), 05-Exam/2026 (ASO / ARO Statistics) or 01-Exam/2024 (Pharmaceutical Ayurvedic).
  4. Click the notice titled revised answer key (master set).
  5. The PDF opens on the screen. Save it for future reference.

How to Check Your Answers Using the Revised Key

  • Keep your question booklet series or your own answer record ready.
  • Match the question paper set shown in the notice with your booklet.
  • Compare each answer with the revised key.
  • The marking scheme and negative marking details are Not Available Officially in the notice titles, so follow the pattern given in your exam instructions.

Can Candidates Still Raise Objections?

The objection window applied to the provisional answer keys. The revised key is released after the objections were reviewed. Whether any further objection window applies to the revised key is Not Available Officially. Candidates should read the notice on upsssc.gov.in before taking any action.

What Happens After the Revised Answer Key?

The result of each Main Examination is prepared using the revised key. The result date, cut off marks and the details of later stages are Not Yet Announced. Candidates should keep checking the News section of upsssc.gov.in for updates.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Download the notice only from the official UPSSSC website.
  • Check the advertisement number before comparing answers.
  • Match the question paper set with your own booklet.
  • Do not rely on unofficial answer keys for final marks.
  • Keep your registration details safe for the result and later stages.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

  • Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

  • Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

  • Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

  • Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

  • Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

  • Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

  • Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

  • Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

  • Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

  • Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

  • Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

  • Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

  • Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

  • Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

  • Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

  • Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

  • Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

  • Know Postgres and relational database practice.

  • Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

  • Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

  • Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

  • Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

  • Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

  • Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

Role Snapshot

About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

Role Snapshot


ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

Role Snapshot

Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

  • Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

  • Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

  • Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

  • Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

  • Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

  • Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

  • Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

  • Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

  • Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

  • Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for

  • Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

  • Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

  • Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

  • Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential.

Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset.
